lemmas.usage_note: 子宫颈

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the cervix of the uterus

examples.en: cervical cancer

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cervix 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 正式批准，签署生效（条约、协议等）
lemmas.def_en: [T] To make an agreement, treaty, or amendment officially valid by signing or voting for it.

examples.en: The parliament voted overwhelmingly to ratify the international climate treaty.
examples.zh: 议会以压倒性多数投票批准了这项国际气候条约。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式官方语体，指通过签署或投票使条约、法案正式生效，常搭配 treaty 或 agreement。

lemmas.def_en: lacking legal authority

examples.en: the unratified Equal Right Amendment

lemmas.def_zh: 批准, 承认, 认可
lemmas.def_en: making something valid by formally ratifying or confirming it

examples.en: The agreement will enter into force following the ratification of all member states.
examples.zh: 该协议将在所有成员国完成批准程序后正式生效。

lemmas.usage_note: 指批准、认可的法律程序或行为，常与介词 of 连用，多见于政治、外交与法律文书。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ratify 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a unit of potential equal to the potential difference between two points on a conductor carrying a current of 1 ampere when the power dissipated between the two points is 1 watt; equivalent to the potential difference across a resistance of 1 ohm when 1 ampere of current flows through it

examples.en: Standard household electrical outlets in this country supply 120 volts.
examples.zh: 该国的标准家用电源插座提供 120 伏特的电压。

lemmas.usage_note: 物理学电压单位，缩写为 V，常与数词连用修饰电池、电路或家用电器的电压规格。

lemmas.def_en: a group of Niger-Congo languages spoken primarily in southeastern Mali and northern Ghana

family_guide.root_logic: 以 volt 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 花花公子, 乖巧的人
lemmas.def_en: a man devoted to the pursuit of pleasure

examples.en: He had a reputation as a wealthy playboy who spent his time traveling and partying.
examples.zh: 他顶着阔绰花花公子的名头，成天在旅行和派对中虚度光阴。

lemmas.usage_note: 略带贬义或调侃色彩，指生活奢靡、追逐享乐并频繁涉足情场的富家子弟或浪荡公子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 playboy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a metal pot for stewing or boiling; usually has a lid

examples.en: She filled the electric kettle with water and turned it on to make tea.
examples.zh: 她往电水壶里灌满水并通上电，准备沏茶。

lemmas.usage_note: 水壶，烧水壶

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kettle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 刻有浮雕的宝石或贝壳
lemmas.def_en: engraving or carving in low relief on a stone (as in a brooch or ring)

examples.en: She wore an antique shell cameo pinned to the collar of her silk blouse.
examples.zh: 她丝绸衬衫的衣领上别着一枚复古的贝壳浮雕胸针。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指雕刻贝壳或宝石，也可引申指影视剧中的客串角色，常用 a cameo brooch 或 make a cameo appearance。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cameo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 容易被忘的, 可忘记的
lemmas.def_en: easily forgotten

examples.en: Critics dismissed the actor's latest film as an utterly forgettable romantic comedy.
examples.zh: 影评人认为这位演员的最新电影是一部完全不值一提、转眼即忘的浪漫喜剧。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于文艺评论或日常评价，常作表语或定语，带有轻微贬义色彩，常搭配 performance, match, movie。

lemmas.def_zh: 忘不了的, 令人难忘的
lemmas.def_en: impossible to forget

family_guide.root_logic: 以 forgettable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a low area where the land is saturated with water

examples.en: The coastal wetland provides a crucial sanctuary for thousands of migratory birds each winter.
examples.zh: 这片沿海湿地每年冬季都为数以千计的候鸟提供关键的栖息避难所。

lemmas.usage_note: 生态学及地理领域高频词，常用复数形式 wetlands，常与 conservation, ecosystem, restoration 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wetland 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a unit of spoken language larger than a phoneme

examples.en: The poetry teacher asked students to count the syllables in each line of the sonnet.
examples.zh: 诗歌老师让学生们数出这首十四行诗每一行的音节数。

lemmas.usage_note: 语言学名词，常与 stressed, unstressed 搭配；否定句中常用 not breathe a syllable 表示“绝不透露半句”。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to syllables

examples.en: Japanese writing systems include syllabic scripts that represent units of spoken sound.
examples.zh: 日语书写系统包含代表语音单位的音节文字。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 syllable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: given to haughty disregard of others

examples.en: The manager's cavalier attitude toward workplace safety sparked widespread anger among the workers.
examples.zh: 经理对工作场所安全漫不经心的轻率态度引发了工人们的普遍愤怒。

lemmas.usage_note: 常带贬义，形容对重要事务漫不经心、轻率傲慢，常见搭配为 a cavalier attitude towards/about sth。

lemmas.def_en: a gallant or courtly gentleman

examples.en: In the historical pageant, an actor dressed as a dashing cavalier rode through the town square.
examples.zh: 在历史盛装游行中，一名扮作潇洒骑士的演员骑马穿过了城镇广场。

lemmas.usage_note: 历史文化词汇，指骑兵、骑士，或特指英国内战时期的保王党人（大写 Cavalier），书面语色彩浓厚。

lemmas.def_zh: 像骑士般地, 傲慢地
lemmas.def_en: in a proud and domineering manner

examples.en: he treated his staff cavalierly

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cavalier 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: increasing by successive addition

examples.en: The cumulative effect of years of severe sleep deprivation began to damage his health.
examples.zh: 多年严重睡眠不足所产生的累积效应开始损害他的身体健康。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于正式写作、统计与医学报告，形容渐增的总体效果，常修饰 effect, impact, total 或 GPA。

lemmas.def_zh: 累积, 累加, 渐增, 与同一事实相重, 加重
lemmas.def_en: in a cumulative manner

examples.en: mind has become self-reproducing through man's capacity to transmit experience and its products cumulatively

lemmas.def_en: a globular cloud

examples.en: Fluffy white cumulus clouds drifted lazily across the bright summer blue sky.
examples.zh: 蓬松洁白的积云在明朗的夏日蓝天中慵懒地漂移。

lemmas.def_zh: 累积, 堆积, 蓄积
lemmas.def_en: a collection of objects laid on top of each other
1. [I, T] (formal / rare) To gather, heap up, or accumulate gradually into a single mass or total.

examples.en: Snow began to cumulate rapidly along the mountain road during the sudden blizzard.
examples.zh: 在突如其来的暴风雪中，积雪开始在山路上迅速堆积。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cumulative 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: something intended to deceive; deliberate trickery intended to gain an advantage

examples.en: The viral video of an alien landing turned out to be an elaborate internet hoax.
examples.zh: 那段在网上疯传的外星人着陆视频结果被证明是一场精心设计的网络骗局。

lemmas.usage_note: 指旨在误导大众的骗局或恶作剧，常搭配 bomb hoax, internet hoax，动词常与 expose, pull off 连用。

lemmas.def_en: someone who plays practical jokes on others

lemmas.def_zh: 哄骗，戏弄，搞恶作剧欺骗
lemmas.def_en: [T] To trick or deceive someone into believing something false, especially as a practical joke or public fraud.

examples.en: The radio hosts managed to hoax millions of listeners with a fake news broadcast on April Fools' Day.
examples.zh: 电台主持人在愚人节那天用一则虚假新闻广播成功愚弄了数百万听众。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指用精心设计的骗局愚弄某人，常用于被动语态 hoax sb into doing sth，语体偏口语及新闻报道。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hoax 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] When a mother breastfeeds a baby, she feeds it milk directly from her breast.

examples.en: Health organizations recommend that mothers breastfeed their babies exclusively for the first six months.
examples.zh: 卫生组织建议母亲在婴儿出生的前六个月内进行纯母乳喂养。

lemmas.usage_note: 可用作及物或不及物动词，医学育儿高频词，及物时直接接婴儿作宾语，常与 breastfeed exclusively 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 breastfeed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a form containing a set of questions; submitted to people to gain statistical information

examples.en: Participants were asked to fill out a detailed questionnaire regarding their daily eating habits.
examples.zh: 参与者被要求填写一份关于他们日常饮食习惯的详细调查问卷。

lemmas.usage_note: 社会调查与学术研究高频词，动词常搭配 fill out, complete, distribute, design a questionnaire。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 questionnaire 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 工作日，平常日（周一至周五）
lemmas.def_en: any day except Sunday (and sometimes except Saturday)

examples.en: The museum is generally much quieter on a weekday than it is on Saturday or Sunday.
examples.zh: 这家博物馆在工作日通常比在周六或周日要安静得多。

lemmas.phonetic: 工作日，平常日（周一至周五）
lemmas.usage_note: 工作日，平常日（周一至周五）
lemmas.zh: 工作日，平常日（周一至周五）

family_guide.root_logic: 以 weekday 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 触染性的, 会蔓延的
lemmas.def_en: easily diffused or spread as from one person to another

examples.en: Her cheerful energy and contagious laughter immediately brightened the tense meeting room.
examples.zh: 她欢快的活力和富有感染力的笑声瞬间点亮了紧张的会议室。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰疾病、情绪或笑声，常与 disease、laughter 搭配，既指接触传染也指具有感染力。

lemmas.def_en: in a contagious manner

examples.en: she was contagiously bubbly

lemmas.def_zh: 触染, 触染病, 蔓延, 歪风
lemmas.def_en: any disease easily transmitted by contact

examples.en: Economists worried that the banking crisis might trigger a financial contagion across global markets.
examples.zh: 经济学家们担心银行业危机可能会引发全球市场的金融连锁动荡。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数或可数名词，指传染病本身或负面情绪、恶习的扩散蔓延，常与 financial、fear 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 contagious 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 高尚的, 壮观的, 卓越的
lemmas.def_en: inspiring awe; - M.S.Dworkin; - Hamilton Basso

examples.en: The orchestra delivered a sublime performance that held the entire auditorium spellbound.
examples.zh: 管弦乐团带来了一场绝妙的演出，让整座音乐厅的观众听得如痴如醉。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面语褒义词，修饰令人敬畏、极具美感或技艺纯熟之物，常搭配 beauty、art、confidence。

lemmas.def_zh: 净化, 升华作用, 高尚化
lemmas.def_en: (chemistry) a change directly from the solid to the gaseous state without becoming liquid
the product of vaporization of a solid

lemmas.def_zh: 庄严, 崇高, 高尚
lemmas.def_en: nobility in thought or feeling or style

lemmas.def_zh: （使）升华，提升（思想、情感或品质）；（使）（物质）升华
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. (formal) To elevate, purify, or refine feelings, thoughts, or desires into something noble or high-minded. 2. (chemistry) To change directly from a solid into vapor without melting, or cause to do so.

examples.en: Under intense heat in the vacuum chamber, the solid iodine began to sublime into purple vapor.
examples.zh: 在真空舱的高温下，固体碘开始升华成紫色的蒸气。

lemmas.usage_note: 化学上指固态直接转化为气态的升华；文学语境中指使精神或品格纯化、提升到更高境界。

lemmas.def_zh: （使）升华；使高尚化，净化（本能冲动）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (physics / chemistry) to change directly from a solid to a gas or vice versa without becoming liquid. 2. [T] (psychology) to redirect primal or unacceptable impulses into socially constructive activities.
completely; in a lofty and exalted manner

examples.en: awaking in me, sublimely unconscious, interest and energy for tackling these tasks

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sublime 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To connect with one another, or to connect two or more things, so that they form an integrated system.

examples.en: A series of paved trails interconnect the university campuses, making cycling convenient for students.
examples.zh: 数条铺就的步道将各个大学校区相互连接，极大地方便了学生骑行。

lemmas.usage_note: 可用作及物或不及物动词，指系统、道路或观点互相联结或使相互贯通，常与 with 搭配。

lemmas.def_en: a state of being connected reciprocally

examples.en: an interconnection between the two buildings

lemmas.def_en: a state of being connected reciprocally

examples.en: an interconnection between the two buildings

family_guide.root_logic: 以 interconnect 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 盛会, 游行, 虚饰, 露天表演
lemmas.def_en: an elaborate representation of scenes from history etc; usually involves a parade with rich costumes

examples.en: Hundreds of locals in traditional costumes participated in the annual historical pageant.
examples.zh: 数百名身着传统服饰的当地居民参加了一年一度的历史盛装游行。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，常指选美比赛（beauty pageant）、历史盛装游行或比喻变幻莫测的盛景。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pageant 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 节流阀, 节气阀, 喉咙
lemmas.def_en: a valve that regulates the supply of fuel to the engine

examples.en: The pilot pushed the throttle forward, and the aircraft accelerated rapidly down the runway.
examples.zh: 飞行员向前推下油门，飞机在跑道上迅猛加速。

lemmas.usage_note: 指机械的节气门或油门，常见短语有 at full throttle（全速地、全力以赴地）。

lemmas.def_zh: 掐死，勒死，使窒息；扼杀，抑制；节流，调节（引擎节气门）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To choke or strangle someone by squeezing their throat tightly. 2. [T] To suppress, choke back, or prevent the development of something. 3. [T] To control the speed or flow of an engine with a throttle.

examples.en: Excessive regulations threaten to throttle innovation in the emerging technology sector.
examples.zh: 过度的监管可能会扼杀新兴技术领域的创新。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，本义为掐死或扼喉，引申指强行压制、阻碍经济增长或自由，常与 back 连用表示减速。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 throttle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 深思熟虑，仔细琢磨（常与 over 连用）；加香料温热（酒等）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (usually 'mull over') To think carefully and at length about something before deciding. 2. [T] To heat wine or cider with sugar and spices.

examples.en: The committee decided to take a week to mull over the proposed budget revisions.
examples.zh: 委员会决定花一周时间仔细斟酌提出的预算修改方案。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用短语 mull over 表示反复斟酌或深思熟虑；亦可表示加糖和香料制作温热饮品（如 mulled wine）。

lemmas.def_zh: 磨杵, 粉碎机, 研磨机
lemmas.def_en: Swiss chemist who synthesized DDT and discovered its use as an insecticide (1899-1965)

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mull 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 狼吞虎咽地吃，吞食；如饥似渴地阅读（或观赏）；吞噬，毁灭
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To eat food quickly, greedily, and completely. 2. [T] To read, look at, or listen to something with intense eagerness. 3. [T] (of fire, disease, or emotion) To consume or destroy something completely.

examples.en: The blazing wildfire threatened to devour several residential neighborhoods overnight.
examples.zh: 肆虐的野火一夜之间有吞噬数个居民区的危险。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指狼吞虎咽地吃，引申为如饥似渴地阅读、烈火吞噬或强烈的感情彻底占据某人。

lemmas.def_en: someone who eats greedily or voraciously

family_guide.root_logic: 以 devour 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 故障, 失灵, 疾病
lemmas.def_en: a failure to function normally

examples.en: The flight was delayed due to a minor electrical malfunction detected during pre-flight checks.
examples.zh: 由于起飞前检查中发现一处轻微电路故障，航班延误了。

lemmas.usage_note: 指机器、系统或器官的功能失常或故障，常与 mechanical、system 等词搭配。

lemmas.def_en: [I] (of a machine, system, or organ) To fail to function or work properly.

examples.en: If the navigation sensors malfunction, the autonomous vehicle will automatically pull over.
examples.zh: 如果导航传感器发生故障，自动驾驶车辆将自动靠边停车。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，指设备、软件或身体部位停止正常运转、出故障，多用于技术或正式语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 malfunction 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (Islam) the man who leads prayers in a mosque; for Shiites an imam is a recognized authority on Islamic theology and law and a spiritual guide

examples.en: The local imam delivered a sermon on peace and charity to the assembled worshippers.
examples.zh: 当地阿訇向聚集的礼拜信众发表了一场关于和平与施舍的布道。

lemmas.usage_note: 专有名词性普通名词，指伊斯兰教清真寺带领礼拜的阿訇或什叶派领袖，通常作主语或称谓。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 imam 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a loud harsh or strident noise

examples.en: We could barely hear each other speak above the terrible din of the construction site.
examples.zh: 在建筑工地震耳欲聋的嘈杂声中，我们几乎听不清彼此说话。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作单数（a din），指持续、震耳欲聋且令人烦躁的嘈杂声，常与 make、above 搭配。

lemmas.def_zh: 大声喧闹，喧嚷；反复叮嘱，絮叨灌输
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] to make a loud, unpleasant, or confusing noise. 2. [T] to instill or repeat something wearyingly into someone's head.

examples.en: The coach continually dinned the fundamental rules of defense into the young players.
examples.zh: 教练不断向年轻球员们反复灌输防守的基本准则。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与 into 连用（din sth into sb），表示反复灌输、唠叨使人铭记，或指持续制造噪音鸣响。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 din 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 船岸之间的水区, 锚地, 卧铺
lemmas.def_en: a job in an organization

examples.en: I managed to book a lower berth on the overnight train to Edinburgh.
examples.zh: 我设法订到了去往爱丁堡的夜间列车下铺。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指火车轮船的卧铺或港口的泊位，习语give a wide berth to表示对某人或某物避而远之。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] (of a ship) To tie up or dock at an assigned place; to guide a ship into a berth.

examples.en: The cruise shipberthed safely at the pier after a turbulent journey.
examples.zh: 这艘邮轮在历经汹涌风浪后，安全停靠在码头。

lemmas.usage_note: 作动词既可用作及物动词（使船停泊），也可用作不及物动词（船停靠码头），常见于航运语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 berth 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a run that is the result of the batter's performance

examples.en: The batter drove in two runs with a sharp single, adding to his season's RBI total.
examples.zh: 击球手以一记利落的平飞单打送回两分，增加了他本赛季的打点总数。

lemmas.usage_note: 棒球专业术语，为run batted in的缩写，指打点，用于衡量击球员送队友或自己得分的能力。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rbi 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 流入, 河口, 汇集
lemmas.def_en: the process of flowing in

examples.en: The coastal town experiences a huge influx of tourists every summer.
examples.zh: 每年夏天，这座沿海小镇都会迎来大批游客的涌入。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与介词of连用，指大量人员、资金或事物涌入某地，常与massive、huge等形容词搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 influx 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of numerous fruits of the genus Citrus having thick rind and juicy pulp; grown in warm regions

examples.en: Oranges, lemons, and grapefruits are all common types of citrus.
examples.zh: 橙子、柠檬和葡萄柚都属于常见的柑橘类水果。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指柑橘类果树或其果实，常用作名词修饰语，如citrus fruit（柑橘类水果）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 citrus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 干酪质的, 俊俏的, 优秀的
lemmas.def_en: of very poor quality; flimsy

examples.en: He gave a cheesy grin when he realized his prank had actually worked.
examples.zh: 当意识到自己的恶作剧奏效时，他露出了俗气的傻笑。

lemmas.usage_note: 口语常用词，既可指含有奶酪味的，也多用于贬义指俗气的、做作的或质量低劣的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cheesy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or near the abdomen

examples.en: Regular core exercises will significantly strengthen your abdominal muscles.
examples.zh: 经常进行核心锻炼能显著增强你的腹部肌肉。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学或生理学正式词汇，指腹部的，常与pain、muscles、cramps等词搭配使用。

lemmas.def_en: the region of the body of a vertebrate between the thorax and the pelvis

examples.en: The patient complained of a dull ache in the lower part of his abdomen.
examples.zh: 病人主诉其下腹部有隐隐的钝痛。

lemmas.usage_note: 解剖学及医学正式用语，指躯干下部的腹部，在昆虫学中指三段体躯的后段。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 abdominal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 电磁的, 由电磁石产生的
lemmas.def_en: pertaining to or exhibiting magnetism produced by electric charge in motion

examples.en: Cell phones emit low levels of electromagnetic radiation during transmission.
examples.zh: 手机在传输信号时会释放出低强度的电磁辐射。

lemmas.usage_note: 物理学专业词汇，常与radiation（辐射）、wave（波）、spectrum（波谱）连用。

lemmas.def_en: magnetism produced by an electric current

examples.en: Maxwell revolutionized modern physics by uniting electricity, magnetism, and light into electromagnetism.
examples.zh: 麦克斯韦将电、磁和光统一为电磁学，彻底改变了现代物理学。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 electromagnetic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a small cake leavened with yeast

examples.en: We finished our dinner with a traditional rum baba served with whipped cream.
examples.zh: 我们在晚餐最后享用了搭配生奶油的传统朗姆巴巴糕。

lemmas.usage_note: 西点专业词汇，指浸泡在朗姆糖浆中的小海绵蛋糕，最常写作rum baba（朗姆巴巴糕）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 baba 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 未烙饲主印记的小牛, 持不同意见的人
lemmas.def_en: someone who exhibits great independence in thought and action

examples.en: As a political maverick, she refused to vote strictly along party lines.
examples.zh: 作为一名特立独行的政客，她拒绝完全遵照党派立场投票。

lemmas.usage_note: 指特立独行、不守常规的人，含褒义或中性，常用于政治、商业或艺术语境中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 maverick 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 领班, 工头, 陪审长
lemmas.def_en: a person who exercises control over workers

examples.en: The foreman carefully inspected the construction site before the workers began their shift.
examples.zh: 工头在工人们换班开工前仔细检查了施工现场。

lemmas.usage_note: 可指工厂或工地的工头领班，亦可指陪审团团长（foreman of the jury），属职场与法律词汇。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 foreman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a place (as at a frontier) where travellers are stopped for inspection and clearance

examples.en: Drivers must show their official identification papers at the border security checkpoint.
examples.zh: 司机必须在边境安全检查站出示其官方身份证件。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 checkpoint 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: something of sentimental value

examples.en: She bought a painted ceramic plate as a souvenir of her unforgettable trip.
examples.zh: 她买了一个彩绘瓷盘，作为这段难忘旅程的纪念品。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 souvenir 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the physical property of a material that can return to its original shape or position after deformation that does not exceed its elastic limit

examples.en: The resilience of the alloy allows it to absorb impact without deforming.
examples.zh: 这种合金的弹性使其能够吸收冲击力而不发生形变。

lemmas.def_en: an occurrence of rebounding or springing back
recovering readily from adversity, depression, or the like

examples.en: Local businesses proved remarkably resilient despite the severe economic challenges this year.
examples.zh: 尽管今年面临严峻的经济挑战，当地企业仍表现出极强的韧性。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 resilience 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: infection transmitted by inhalation or ingestion of tubercle bacilli and manifested in fever and small lesions (usually in the lungs but in various other parts of the body in acute stages)

examples.en: Modern antibiotics have made pulmonary tuberculosis a curable disease in most cases.
examples.zh: 现代抗生素已使肺结核在大多数情况下成为一种可治愈的疾病。

lemmas.def_en: a swelling that is the characteristic lesion of tuberculosis

examples.en: The doctor identified a small, benign tubercle on the patient's forearm during the exam.
examples.zh: 医生在体检中发现患者前臂上有一个良性小结节。

lemmas.def_zh: 有结核的, 结节的, 结核的
lemmas.def_en: characterized by the presence of tuberculosis lesions or tubercles

examples.en: The doctor examined the chest X-ray carefully for any signs of tubercular infection.
examples.zh: 医生仔细检查了胸部X光片，寻找结核感染的迹象。

lemmas.def_zh: 有结节的, 结节状的, 患结核病的
lemmas.def_en: constituting or afflicted with or caused by tuberculosis or the tubercle bacillus

examples.en: a tubercular child
tuberculous patients

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tuberculosis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an enthusiastic and vocal supporter

examples.en: She was chosen as the head cheerleader for the upcoming football tournament.
examples.zh: 她被选为即将举行的高校橄榄球锦标赛的啦啦队长。

lemmas.def_zh: 担任拉拉队员；极力声援，竭力支持
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To perform cheers to support a sports team, or to enthusiastically promote and champion a person or cause.

examples.en: The mayor continued to cheerlead the controversial development project despite strong local protests.
examples.zh: 尽管当地抗议强烈，市长仍继续大力支持这项有争议的开发项目。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cheerleader 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the shore of a sea or ocean regarded as a resort

examples.en: We spent a relaxing weekend at a quiet seaside hotel near the coast.
examples.zh: 我们在海岸边一家安静的海滨酒店度过了一个轻松的周末。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 seaside 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a carbonaceous material obtained by heating wood or other organic matter in the absence of air

examples.en: He added more charcoal to the grill before cooking the fresh vegetables.
examples.zh: 他在烤新鲜蔬菜之前，往烤架里多加了一些木炭。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 charcoal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a light soft silver-white metallic element of the alkali metal group; oxidizes rapidly in air and reacts violently with water; is abundant in nature in combined forms occurring in sea water and in carnallite and kainite and sylvite

examples.en: Bananas are widely known to be an excellent natural source of potassium.
examples.zh: 众所周知，香蕉是钾元素的绝佳天然来源。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 potassium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 懊悔, 良心不安, 自责, 同情
lemmas.def_en: a feeling of deep regret (usually for some misdeed)

examples.en: The defendant showed genuine remorse for his reckless actions during the trial.
examples.zh: 被告在审判期间对自己的鲁莽行为表现出真诚的懊悔。

lemmas.def_zh: 极为后悔的, 懊悔的
lemmas.def_en: feeling or expressing pain or sorrow for sins or offenses

lemmas.def_zh: 无怜悯之心的, 冷酷的, 不知自责的
lemmas.def_en: without mercy or pity

examples.en: an act of ruthless ferocity
a monster of remorseless cruelty

lemmas.def_en: without pity; in a merciless manner

examples.en: he was mercilessly trounced by his opponent in the House

lemmas.def_en: in a rueful manner

examples.en: `I made a big mistake,' he said ruefully

family_guide.root_logic: 以 remorse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 汉堡(德国港口), 肉饼, 汉堡包, 纯精牛肉, 汉堡牛排
lemmas.def_en: a sandwich consisting of a fried cake of minced beef served on a bun, often with other ingredients

examples.en: He ordered a juicy hamburger with a side of crispy golden fries.
examples.zh: 他点了一份多汁的汉堡包，配上一份金黄酥脆的薯条。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hamburger 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. to balance or hold something steadily in a particular position. 2. to be or put in a state of balance or readiness for action.

examples.en: The hawk poised high in the sky before suddenly diving down toward its prey.
examples.zh: 老鹰在空中盘旋悬停，随后突然俯冲向猎物。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作及物或不及物动词，多用于被动语态或分词结构，常见搭配如 be poised to do（蓄势待发）。

lemmas.def_zh: 平衡, 均衡, 姿势, 镇静, 安静, 砝码
lemmas.def_en: a cgs unit of dynamic viscosity equal to one dyne-second per square centimeter; the viscosity of a fluid in which a force of one dyne per square centimeter maintains a velocity of 1 centimeter per second

examples.en: Throughout the aggressive interview, the diplomat never lost her remarkable poise.
examples.zh: 在整场极具攻击性的采访中，这位外交官始终未失从容沉着的气度。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，主要指优雅从容的举止、镇定自若的神态或身体的平衡感，常作 maintain/lose one's poise。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 沉着的；准备就绪的；平衡的
lemmas.def_en: having a composed and self-assured manner; ready or prepared to do something
lemmas.usage_note: 常与介词 to 或 for 连用，表示“蓄势待发的”；作定语时多形容人举止从容大方。

examples.en: She remained calm and poised throughout the rigorous interview.
examples.zh: 在整个严格的面谈过程中，她始终保持从容镇定。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 poise 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: marked by prudence or modesty and wise self-restraint

examples.en: She made a few discreet inquiries to find out why the manager had left so abruptly.
examples.zh: 她私下谨慎地打听了几句，想弄清经理为何走得如此匆忙。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容人在言行举止上谨慎、保密或不引人注目，常修饰 inquiry、manner 或做表语修饰人。

lemmas.def_en: with discretion; prudently and with wise self-restraint

examples.en: I sent for the sergeant of the platoon both men were in and asked him to try to find out discreetly what lay behind this

family_guide.root_logic: 以 discreet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (+ up) (British English) To clean a floor or carpet using a vacuum cleaner.

examples.en: I need to hoover the living room rug before the guests arrive this evening.
examples.zh: 今晚客人到达之前，我得用吸尘器把客厅的地毯打扫一下。

lemmas.usage_note: 英式口语高频词，及物或不及物皆可，表示吸尘，常搭配 hoover up（狼吞虎咽或迅速吞并）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hoover 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who escorts and protects a prominent person

examples.en: The foreign celebrity was escorted to the venue by a team of armed bodyguards.
examples.zh: 这位外国明星在一队武装保镖的护送下前往活动现场。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指保镖、卫士，既可指单个人，也可集合性指代整组贴身护卫人员，常作 hire a bodyguard。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bodyguard 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 排挤，使边缘化，使处于次要地位
lemmas.def_en: [T] To treat a person, group, or viewpoint as insignificant and push them to the fringes of society or an organization.

examples.en: Rapid technological advances must not marginalize workers who lack digital literacy.
examples.zh: 技术的飞速进步绝不能将缺乏数字化素养的劳动者边缘化。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常用于社会学、政治及学术语境，多以被动语态出现，表示排挤或边缘化某群体。

lemmas.def_zh: 使边缘化，排斥，使处于非主流地位
lemmas.def_en: [T] To treat a person, group, or concept as insignificant or peripheral, pushing them to the margins of society.

examples.en: We must not marginalize the poor in our society

lemmas.def_en: the social process of becoming or being made marginal (especially as a group within the larger society)

examples.en: the marginalization of the underclass
the marginalization of literature

family_guide.root_logic: 以 marginalize 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a storm with widespread snowfall accompanied by strong winds

examples.en: The severe blizzard brought the entire northern city to a standstill overnight.
examples.zh: 这场猛烈的暴风雪一夜之间让整座北方城市陷入瘫痪。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，本义为暴风雪，引申指雪片般飞来的事物，常见搭配 a blizzard of paperwork/complaints。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 blizzard 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 懊悔, 后悔, 芸香
lemmas.def_en: European strong-scented perennial herb with grey-green bitter-tasting leaves; an irritant similar to poison ivy

examples.en: The ancient medicinal recipe called for a handful of freshly picked rue leaves.
examples.zh: 这剂古老的药方需要用到一把新鲜采摘的芸香叶。

lemmas.usage_note: 文学或古风词汇中意为懊悔、悔恨；植物学中指芸香科多年生草本植物，日常多见于习语或旧体诗歌。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (formal or literary) To feel deep regret, sorrow, or remorse for something done or allowed to happen.

examples.en: You will rue the day you decided to ignore the doctor's clear warnings.
examples.zh: 你终究会为你当初无视医生的明确警告而后悔莫及。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，书面语色彩浓厚，多搭配 rue the day（后悔莫及）或以名词、从句作宾语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rue 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 全球化, 普及到世界范围
lemmas.def_en: growth to a global or worldwide scale

examples.en: Economic globalization has integrated local markets into the vast international supply chain.
examples.zh: 经济全球化已将地方市场深深融入庞大的国际供应链中。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，用于经济、文化及政治语境，常搭配 economic globalization 或 the impact of globalization。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To expand operations or influence on a worldwide scale, or cause something to do so.

examples.en: The company plans to globalize its operations by opening branches across Europe and Asia.
examples.zh: 该公司计划通过在欧亚两地开设分部来实现业务全球化。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] (British English) To expand operations or influence on a worldwide scale, or cause something to do so.

examples.en: Markets are being increasingly globalized

family_guide.root_logic: 以 globalization 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使降级，贬低；降低……的重要性
lemmas.def_en: [T] To reduce someone or something to a lower rank, rating, status, or level of importance.

examples.en: The rating agency decided to downgrade the company's credit status to negative.
examples.zh: 信用评级机构决定将该公司的信用评级下调至负面。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常用于金融、航空及行政语境，指调低评级或降低身份待遇，常见搭配 downgrade from... to...

family_guide.root_logic: 以 downgrade 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (古时战争时所用的)燃料剂, 磷火, 鬼火, 野火
lemmas.def_en: a raging and rapidly spreading conflagration

examples.en: Rumors about the sudden management shakeup spread like wildfire throughout the office.
examples.zh: 有关管理层突然重组的传闻如野火般在整个办公室迅速蔓延。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数或不可数名词，指难以控制的野火；最常用于习语 spread like wildfire，比喻消息或谣言迅速传开。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wildfire 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an elementary particle with 0 charge and mass about equal to a proton; enters into the structure of the atomic nucleus

examples.en: A neutron carries no electrical charge and is located within the atomic nucleus.
examples.zh: 中子不带电荷，位于原子核内部。

lemmas.usage_note: 物理学核心名词，常用于科技文献，常见搭配有 neutron star（中子星）和 thermal neutron（热中子）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 neutron 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 否认，拒不承认；放弃（权利、所有权等）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To state publicly that you have no responsibility for, knowledge of, or connection with something. 2. [T] (law) To formally renounce or surrender a legal right or claim.

examples.en: The manufacturer disclaimed all liability for damages caused by misuse.
examples.zh: 制造商对因使用不当造成的损失不承担任何责任。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式法律与商业用语，多作及物动词，常接 responsibility 或 liability 表明免责声明。

lemmas.def_zh: 放弃, 拒负责任, 不承诺
lemmas.def_en: (law) a voluntary repudiation of a person's legal claim to something

family_guide.root_logic: 以 disclaim 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （动物）低吼，咆哮；怒气冲冲地嘟囔；（肚子）咕咕叫
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (+ at) To make a low, deep, threatening sound in the throat, or say something angrily in this way. 2. [I] (of a stomach) To make a rumbling sound.

examples.en: The guard dog growled menacingly at the approaching stranger.
examples.zh: 看门狗对着靠近的陌生人发出威胁性的低吼。

lemmas.usage_note: 可作及物或不及物动词，既指动物低吼，也常引申指人态度恶劣地低声抱怨或吼叫，常接 at。

lemmas.def_zh: 嗥叫的动物, 轰鸣的东西, 咆哮的人
lemmas.def_en: a speaker whose voice sounds like a growl

family_guide.root_logic: 以 growl 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a speech sound made with the vocal tract open

examples.en: In English, the letters A, E, I, O, and U usually represent vowels.
examples.zh: 在英语中，字母A、E、I、O和U通常表示元音。

lemmas.usage_note: 语言学及日常语音学名词，常见搭配包括 short/long vowel（短/长元音）及 vowel sound（元音发音）。

lemmas.def_zh: 元音的, 元音性的, 含元音的
lemmas.def_en: being or containing or characterized by vowels; ; - Walter Scott

examples.en: Linguists studied the unique vocalic shifts that occurred during the language's long development.
examples.zh: 语言学家研究了该语言漫长发展过程中发生的独特元音转变。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vowel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To write something by hand with a pen or pencil rather than by typing or printing.

examples.en: She decided to handwrite the thank-you note to make it more personal.
examples.zh: 她决定手写这封感谢信，以显得更有诚意。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物或不及物动词，强调人工书写而非打字或印刷，过去式和过去分词多作 handwrote, handwritten。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 handwrite 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having a defect

examples.en: The company recalled thousands of vehicles due to defective brakes.
examples.zh: 由于刹车系统存在缺陷，该公司召回了数千辆汽车。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰机械、产品或法律文书，指存在瑕疵或无法正常运作，常与 goods、parts 或 vision 搭配。

lemmas.def_en: in a defective manner

examples.en: this machine functions only defectively

lemmas.def_en: the state of being defective

family_guide.root_logic: 以 defective 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 撤回，收回（言论、承诺等）；缩回，缩进
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To officially withdraw or take back a statement, promise, or accusation. 2. [I, T] To pull or move back inside, or become drawn back inside.

examples.en: The witness retracted her previous statement after new evidence came to light.
examples.zh: 在新的证据曝光后，证人撤回了她之前的证词。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可指物理上的缩回（如爪子、起落架），也常用于正式语境指撤回言论或指控，可作及物或不及物动词。

lemmas.def_en: a disavowal or taking back of a previous assertion

lemmas.def_zh: 食言的人, 牵拉肌, 牵开器
lemmas.def_en: surgical instrument that holds back the edges of a surgical incision

family_guide.root_logic: 以 retract 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 非法侵入，擅入（私人领地）；冒犯，侵害
lemmas.def_en: [I] (+ on/upon) to enter someone's land or property without permission; to intrude on someone's rights or privacy

examples.en: The sign warned hikers not to trespass on private property.
examples.zh: 告示牌警告徒步旅行者不得擅自闯入私人领地。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用作不及物动词，法律语境中指非法侵入他人领地，常与介词 on 或 upon 连用；告示常见 No trespassing。

lemmas.def_zh: 侵害者, 违反者, 侵入者
lemmas.def_en: someone who intrudes on the privacy or property of another without permission

family_guide.root_logic: 以 trespass 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 重新开发，改造，重建（旧区或建筑）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To rebuild, modernize, or develop an urban area, building, or land for a new purpose.

examples.en: The city council plans to redevelop the abandoned industrial waterfront into a park.
examples.zh: 市议会计划将废弃的滨水工业区重新开发为公园。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，多用于城市规划与经济建设语境，常接 land, area, site 或 property 作为宾语。

lemmas.def_en: the act of improving by renewing and restoring

examples.en: they are pursuing a general program of renovation to the entire property
a major overhal of the healthcare system was proposed

family_guide.root_logic: 以 redevelop 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 留心，注意，听从（建议或警告）
lemmas.def_en: [T] (formal) To pay close, serious attention to advice, a warning, or a rule.

examples.en: Motorists failed to heed the warnings about the severe snowstorm ahead.
examples.zh: 驾车者们未能听从关于前方有特大暴风雪的警告。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面语色彩较浓的及物动词，常接 warning, advice 或 call，表示听从、采纳或留心警示。

lemmas.def_zh: 不注意的, 不留心的, 不谨慎的
lemmas.def_en: marked by or paying little heed or attention; --Franklin D. Roosevelt

examples.en: We have always known that heedless self-interest was bad morals; we know now that it is bad economics
heedless of danger

lemmas.def_en: taking heed; giving close and thoughtful attention

examples.en: heedful of the warnings
so heedful a writer

lemmas.def_zh: 掉以轻心地；不加注意地
lemmas.def_en: without care or concern

examples.en: carelessly raised the children's hopes without thinking of their possible disappointment

lemmas.def_en: a lack of attentiveness (as to children or helpless people)

family_guide.root_logic: 以 heed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 歌剧女主角/首席女主角, 主要女歌手
lemmas.def_en: a distinguished female operatic singer; a female operatic star

examples.en: The pop diva refused to take the stage until all her dressing room demands were met.
examples.zh: 这位流行乐天后拒绝登台，直到她的所有化妆间要求都被满足。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指歌剧中的首席女主角或著名流行女歌手，亦可贬义借指自负、难以伺候的大牌明星。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 diva 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 生计, 营生, 生活
lemmas.def_en: the financial means whereby one lives

examples.en: Many coastal fishermen depend on seasonal tourism for their livelihood during the summer.
examples.zh: 许多沿海渔民在夏季依靠季节性旅游业维持生计。

lemmas.usage_note: 指维持生活的方式或收入来源，常与动词 earn、gain 或 lose 搭配，多用于正式语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 livelihood 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a stable particle with positive charge equal to the negative charge of an electron

examples.en: Each hydrogen atom contains a single proton within its nucleus.
examples.zh: 每个氢原子的原子核内都包含一个质子。

lemmas.usage_note: 物理学与化学专业术语，指原子核中的带正电粒子，常用于描述原子结构或核反应机制。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 proton 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a cataclysm resulting from a destructive sea wave caused by an earthquake or volcanic eruption

examples.en: The coastal defenses were heavily damaged by the massive tsunami triggered by an undersea earthquake.
examples.zh: 沿海防汛设施被海底地震引发的巨大海啸严重损毁。

lemmas.usage_note: 多指由海底地震等引发的巨大海啸，也可引申比喻如潮水般涌来的大量事物或强烈情绪。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tsunami 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any plant of the genus Veronica

examples.en: In the early days of the Internet, users relied on Veronica to search for files across Gopher servers.
examples.zh: 在互联网早期，用户依赖Veronica检索程序在Gopher服务器群中查找文件。

lemmas.usage_note: 早期互联网早期基于Gopher协议的索引检索系统；亦可作植物名（婆婆纳属）或斗牛动作术语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 veronica 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 莴苣, 生菜, 纸币
lemmas.def_en: informal terms for money

examples.en: She added a generous handful of crisp lettuce to the fresh chicken salad.
examples.zh: 她在新鲜的鸡肉沙拉里加了一大把爽脆的生菜。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数或可数名词，指蔬菜莴苣、生菜；在美式俚语中亦可幽默指代纸币、钞票（因其呈绿色）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lettuce 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an adult castrated bull of the genus Bos; especially Bos taurus

examples.en: The farmer used a pair of oxen to plow the rocky hillside field.
examples.zh: 农夫用一对公牛耕作那片布满碎石的山坡地。

lemmas.usage_note: 指阉割过的公牛，多用于农耕或役使，复数形式为 oxen；常见成语为 strong as an ox（健壮如牛）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ox 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] (formal) To remember something, especially by making an effort to recall it.

examples.en: As he grew older, the author could distinctly recollect the events of his early childhood.
examples.zh: 随着年龄增长，这位作家能够清晰地忆起自己早年童年的点滴经历。

lemmas.usage_note: 作及物或不及物动词，指主动努力从记忆中搜寻并忆起往事，语体较 remember 更为正式书面。

lemmas.def_zh: 记忆, 回想, 回忆
lemmas.def_en: the ability to recall past occurrences

family_guide.root_logic: 以 recollect 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: something that is lost or surrendered as a penalty

examples.en: His property was seized as a forfeit for breaking the terms of the commercial treaty.
examples.zh: 由于违反商业条约的条款，他的财产被充作没收物罚没。

lemmas.usage_note: 罚金，没收物，丧失物

lemmas.def_zh: 没收物, 罚金, 丧失
lemmas.def_en: something that is lost or surrendered as a penalty

examples.en: Failure to fulfill the contract could result in the forfeiture of the entire deposit.
examples.zh: 未能履行合同可能导致全部定金被依法罚没。

lemmas.usage_note: 法律与正式语境中的名词，指失去、丧失某项权利或财产的法定义务或行为过程。

lemmas.def_zh: （因违规或受罚而）失去，丧失，被没收
lemmas.def_en: [T] To lose property, money, a right, or a privilege as a penalty for breaking a rule or failing to meet an obligation.

examples.en: The visiting team was forced to forfeit the match after failing to arrive on time.
examples.zh: 客队因未能按时到达而被判定弃权输掉比赛。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指因过失、违规或放弃而丧失权利、资格、金钱等，常见搭配 forfeit the right/game。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 forfeit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 大方的, 丰富的, 浪费的
lemmas.def_en: very generous

examples.en: The wealthy entrepreneur hosted a lavish banquet to celebrate his company's anniversary.
examples.zh: 这位富有的企业家举办了一场极其奢华的晚宴来庆祝公司周年纪念。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，修饰宴会、礼物或生活方式，表示极其奢华的、慷慨过度的，常与 on/with 搭配。

lemmas.def_zh: 慷慨给予，过多地给予；过分挥霍
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (+ on/upon) To give someone a huge amount of money, praise, care, or attention generously.

examples.en: Grandparents often lavish expensive gifts and boundless affection on their grandchildren.
examples.zh: 祖父母往往毫不吝惜地给孙辈送去昂贵的礼物与无限的溺爱。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，表示慷慨地给予、不吝惜地倾注，常用搭配为 lavish something on/upon somebody/something。

lemmas.def_en: in a wasteful manner

examples.en: the United States, up to the 1920s, used fuel lavishly, mainly because it was so cheap

lemmas.def_en: the quality possessed by something that is excessively expensive

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lavish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 猛投，用力掷；厉声说出，大声叫骂（侮辱等）
lemmas.def_en: [T] To throw something with great force or violence; to utter insults or accusations vehemently.

examples.en: Angry protesters began to hurl stones and abuse at the riot police.
examples.zh: 愤怒的抗议者开始向防暴警察猛扔石块并大肆辱骂。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指用力投掷重物，引申为猛烈倾倒恶言或指责；常与 at、into 连用，多见于冲突或情绪宣泄语境。

lemmas.def_en: (baseball) the person who does the pitching

examples.en: our pitcher has a sore arm

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hurl 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 制服，征服，压制；抑制，克制（感情）；减弱，降低（光线、声音等）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To bring a person, crowd, or rebellion under control by force; defeat. 2. [T] To suppress or control strong feelings. 3. [T] To make something less intense or bright.

examples.en: Troops were called in to subdue the rebellion in the southern province.
examples.zh: 军队被召集去平定南部省份的叛乱。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指用武力制服对手或克制内心情感、减弱光线声音等，常见搭配为 subdue one's anger/desire。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 压抑的；柔和的；闷闷不乐的
lemmas.def_en: quiet and rather reflective or depressed; (of color or light) not bright
lemmas.usage_note: 可形容光线、色彩等柔和不刺眼，也可形容人的情绪或气氛低落、克制。

examples.en: The celebration was subdued following the sudden sad news.
examples.zh: 突如其来的悲伤消息传来后，庆祝活动的气氛变得压抑起来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 subdue 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 身分低微之老妇, 糖果, 姥姥
lemmas.def_en: something considered choice to eat

examples.en: The children's eyes lit up when they saw the table laden with sweet goodies.
examples.zh: 当孩子们看到摆满甜食点心的桌子时，眼睛都亮了起来。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式名词，复数 goodies 极常用，指好吃的东西或吸引人的物品；单数亦可戏谑指正派角色或老妇人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 goody 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 为钱而工作的, 被雇的, 图利的
lemmas.def_en: marked by materialism

examples.en: She was disgusted by his purely mercenary attitude toward their marriage.
examples.zh: 他对待婚姻完全唯利是图的态度让她感到厌恶。

lemmas.usage_note: 作形容词时具贬义，指唯利是图的动机或行动，常修饰 motive、attitude 或 society。

lemmas.def_zh: 唯利是图者, 雇佣兵
lemmas.def_en: a person hired to fight for another country than their own

examples.en: The warlord hired foreign mercenaries to defend the diamond mines.
examples.zh: 军阀雇佣了外国雇佣兵来保卫钻石矿。

lemmas.usage_note: 作可数名词，指为了金钱受雇参战的雇佣兵，也可比喻指受金钱驱使替人卖命的工具人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mercenary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不相容的, 不能并存的, 矛盾的
lemmas.def_en: not compatible

examples.en: His extravagant lifestyle is completely incompatible with his modest income.
examples.zh: 他挥霍无度的生活方式与其微薄的收入完全不相容。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示性格不合、事物无法共存或技术设备不兼容，常与介词 with 搭配使用，书面语与科技语境中常用。

lemmas.def_zh: 互不相容的东西, 不相容
lemmas.def_en: the relation between propositions that cannot both be true at the same time

family_guide.root_logic: 以 incompatible 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 声称，自称（常含虚假或缺乏依据之意）；标榜
lemmas.def_en: [T] (+ to be/do) (formal) To claim or profess to be or do something, especially falsely or without proof.

examples.en: The leaked document purports to show that the company covered up the chemical leak.
examples.zh: 这份泄露的文件声称表明该公司掩盖了化学品泄漏事件。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面语动词，多用 purport to be/do，表示自称或声称某事（但真实性常存疑），后接不定式。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 purport 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 宿醉, 残留物, 遗物
lemmas.def_en: disagreeable aftereffects from the use of drugs (especially alcohol)

examples.en: The country's current economic stagnation is a hangover from decades of mismanagement.
examples.zh: 该国目前的经济停滞是数十年来管理不善的历史遗留后果。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，既指宿醉的身体不适，也指历史或旧时代的遗留问题，常与 from 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hangover 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 令人悲伤的, 极其累人的, 令人动情的
lemmas.def_en: causing or marked by grief or anguish

examples.en: It was heartbreaking to see the flood victims search through the ruins for their belongings.
examples.zh: 看着洪水灾民在废墟中翻找自己的物品，真是令人心碎。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，指事件、消息或遭遇极其令人心碎与悲痛，常用于修饰 story、loss、sight 或 scene。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 heartbreaking 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the trait of keeping things secret

examples.en: The negotiations were conducted in absolute secrecy to avoid public panic.
examples.zh: 为了避免引起公众恐慌，谈判是在绝对保密的状态下进行的。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，强调“保密的状态或行为”，常见搭配有 in secrecy（秘密地）或 swear sb to secrecy（令某人发誓保密）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 secrecy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (环境)卫生, 环境卫生的提倡/维持, 卫生设备, 下水道设施, 卫生设施
lemmas.def_en: the state of being clean and conducive to health

examples.en: Overcrowded refugee camps often suffer from a severe lack of basic sanitation.
examples.zh: 拥挤不堪的难民营通常严重缺乏基本的公共卫生设施。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，专指公共卫生设施（如排污、下水道）或环境卫生维持系统，常见于公共政策和发展援助话题。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sanitation 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: widely cultivated for its fragrant grey-green leaves used in cooking and in perfumery

examples.en: Add a fresh sprig of rosemary to the roasted potatoes for extra aroma.
examples.zh: 在烤土豆里加一小枝新鲜迷迭香以增添香气。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作不可数名词指烹饪香草，也作可数名词指该植物；常见搭配有 fresh rosemary、sprig of rosemary。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rosemary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the lowest stone in an arch -- from which it springs

examples.en: The coach praised the high jumper as a natural springer with exceptional leg strength.
examples.zh: 教练称赞这位跳高运动员是个天生的弹跳好手，腿部力量惊人。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指起跳者或跳跃之物，亦常用于犬种名（如 Springer Spaniel）；语境偏书面或专业分类。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 springer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 盛气凌人地威吓，威逼，欺凌
lemmas.def_en: [T] To talk to or treat someone in a loud, aggressive, bullying way to force them to do something.

examples.en: The manager tried to hector his subordinates into accepting the unfair overtime demands.
examples.zh: 经理试图通过恐吓威逼下属接受不公平的加班要求。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物或不及物动词，指以盛气凌人之势威逼、欺凌他人；常见搭配为 hector sb into doing sth，具贬义。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hector 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a commercial center and river port in western Germany on the Rhine River; flourished during the 15th century as a member of the Hanseatic League

examples.en: He wore a subtle cologne that left a pleasant, lingering fragrance in the room.
examples.zh: 他喷了淡淡的古龙水，在房间里留下一股宜人的余香。

lemmas.usage_note: 多作不可数名词指古龙水或淡香水；首字母大写时指德国城市科隆；常用搭配为 wear cologne、splash of cologne。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cologne 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 未命名的, 没有名字的, 未提及的
lemmas.def_en: being or having an unknown or unnamed source

examples.en: The policy change was leaked to the press by an unnamed senior official.
examples.zh: 这项政策变动是由一位不愿具名的高级官员向媒体透露的。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，指未命名的或未具名的；新闻报道中极高频搭配为 an unnamed source 或 unnamed officials。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unnamed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a disorder of the central nervous system characterized by loss of consciousness and convulsions

examples.en: Modern medications help most patients with epilepsy lead completely normal lives.
examples.zh: 现代药物能帮助大多数癫痫患者过上完全正常的生活。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数医学名词，指癫痫症；高频搭配包括 suffer from epilepsy、diagnose epilepsy 及 epilepsy medication。

lemmas.def_en: a person who has epilepsy

family_guide.root_logic: 以 epilepsy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 下放权力，使非集权化；分散（机构或职能）
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To transfer authority, functions, or administrative power from a single central body to regional or local units.

examples.en: The organization decided to decentralize authority by empowering local branches to make hiring decisions.
examples.zh: 该机构决定下放权力，允许各分支部门自行做出招聘决策。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物或不及物动词，指把权力、机构或人口分散下放；常用于政治、管理语境，如 decentralize power/decision-making。

lemmas.def_zh: 分散, 权力分散, 权力下放
lemmas.def_en: the social process in which population and industry moves from urban centers to outlying districts

family_guide.root_logic: 以 decentralize 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a small book usually having a paper cover

examples.en: Volunteers handed out an informative pamphlet explaining how to vote in the upcoming election.
examples.zh: 志愿者们分发了一份内容详实的宣传小册子，解释如何在即将举行的选举中投票。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指宣传或介绍性的小册子；常见搭配包括 distribute/hand out pamphlets、information pamphlet。

lemmas.def_zh: 小册子作者, 檄文执笔者
lemmas.def_en: a writer of pamphlets (usually taking a partisan stand on public issues)

examples.en: The political pamphleteer distributed thousands of passionate tracts throughout the capital city.
examples.zh: 这位政治檄文执笔者在整个首都分发了数千份充满激情的传单。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pamphlet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an informal photograph; usually made with a small hand-held camera

examples.en: The survey provides a fascinating snapshot of consumer spending habits during the recession.
examples.zh: 该项调查生动展现了经济衰退期消费者支出习惯的简要面貌。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，既指快照照片，也引申为简短的总体概况；高频搭配为 take a snapshot、a snapshot of society/the market。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 snapshot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an elaborate song for solo voice

examples.en: The soprano received a standing ovation after singing the emotionally charged aria from Puccini's opera.
examples.zh: 女高音歌唱家演唱了普契尼歌剧中充满激情的咏叹调后，全场起立鼓掌。

lemmas.usage_note: 咏叹调

family_guide.root_logic: 以 aria 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: being or having light colored skin and hair and usually blue or grey eyes

examples.en: She decided to dye her naturally dark hair blond for the summer vacation.
examples.zh: 她决定趁暑假把自己原本乌黑的头发染成金色。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰头发、肤色或外貌，常与hair、streaks搭配；传统上修饰男性用blond，女性多用blonde。

lemmas.def_en: a person with fair skin and hair

examples.en: The tall blond standing by the doorway turned out to be our new exchange student.
examples.zh: 站在门边的那个高个子金发男子原来是我们的新交换生。

lemmas.usage_note: 指金发白肤的人，特指男性时拼作blond，女性多写作blonde，日常口语及非正式描述中常见。

lemmas.def_en: the property of having a naturally light complexion

family_guide.root_logic: 以 blond 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 扭打，搏斗；努力对付，竭力解决
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To wrestle or struggle closely with someone. 2. [I] ('grapple with') To try hard to deal with or overcome a difficult problem or challenge.

examples.en: The government is struggling to grapple with soaring inflation and rising unemployment.
examples.zh: 政府正竭力应对急剧攀升的通货膨胀和日益严重的失业问题。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用作不及物动词，常与with连用表示“努力克服困难”或“与……扭打”，书面语和新闻中多用于抽象问题。

lemmas.def_en: combatant who tries to throw opponent to the ground

family_guide.root_logic: 以 grapple 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the number that is represented as a one followed by 6 zeros

examples.en: Meg showed me the family album and introduced her cousins one by one.
examples.zh: 梅格给我看了家庭相册，并逐一介绍了她的表亲们。

lemmas.usage_note: 专有名词，为女性教名Margaret的常见昵称；在非正式技术语境中也可作为兆字节（megabyte）的口语缩写。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 meg 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: firm chewy candy made from caramelized sugar and butter and milk

examples.en: The pastry chef drizzled hot caramel over the freshly baked apple pie.
examples.zh: 糕点师在刚出炉的苹果派上淋上了热热的焦糖酱。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可指熬煮焦糖这种调味原料，也可指焦糖夹心软糖；常与pudding、syrup搭配，用于甜品制作与餐饮语境。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] to heat sugar or food containing sugar until it turns brown and sweet, or to undergo this change.

examples.en: The sugar caramelized

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] (British English) to heat sugar or food containing sugar until it turns brown and sweet, or to undergo this change.

examples.en: The sugar caramelized

family_guide.root_logic: 以 caramel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 恰当地, 充分地, 适当地, 及时地
lemmas.def_en: at the proper time

examples.en: After reviewing the terms, all committee members duly signed the official contract.
examples.zh: 审阅条款后，所有委员会成员均已如期在正式合同上签字。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面副词，常置于动词（尤其是过去分词）前，表示“按期、适当地”或“果真如预期”，多见于公文与法律文书。

lemmas.def_en: to an undue degree

examples.en: she was unduly pessimistic about her future

family_guide.root_logic: 以 duly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 藤架, 树, 心轴, 凉亭
lemmas.def_en: tree (as opposed to shrub)

examples.en: We sat beneath the grapevine arbor in the backyard to escape the midday heat.
examples.zh: 我们坐在后院的葡萄藤架下避暑，躲开正午的烈日。

lemmas.usage_note: 指花园中由攀缘植物遮盖的藤架或林荫凉亭；在机械学中也可指心轴。常用于园艺、景观或建筑描写。

lemmas.def_en: a specialist in treating damaged trees
of or relating to or formed by trees

examples.en: an arborous roof

family_guide.root_logic: 以 arbor 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To touch or abuse someone, especially a child, sexually. 2. [T] (formal or dated) To annoy, assault, or interfere with someone in a harmful way.

examples.en: The suspect was arrested after being accused of attempting to molest a minor in the park.
examples.zh: 该嫌疑人因被指控涉嫌在公园内猥亵一名未成年人而被警方逮捕。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，现代主要用于法律与新闻语境，指“猥亵”或“性侵犯”，在文学或旧式语体中亦可指蓄意骚扰、妨害。

lemmas.def_zh: 调戏, 干扰, 妨碍
lemmas.def_en: the act of subjecting someone to unwanted or improper sexual advances or activity (especially women or children)

family_guide.root_logic: 以 molest 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a shop where books are sold

examples.en: I spent a quiet afternoon browsing through old poetry collections in the local bookstore.
examples.zh: 我在当地书店里翻阅旧诗集，度过了一个宁静的下午。

lemmas.usage_note: 美式英语常用词（英式多用bookshop），指销售图书的实体商店，常与independent、online连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bookstore 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 排, 一组, 一群人
lemmas.def_en: a military unit that is a subdivision of a company; usually has a headquarters and two or more squads; usually commanded by a lieutenant

examples.en: The lieutenant ordered his platoon to secure the perimeter before nightfall.
examples.zh: 中尉命令他的排在天黑之前守住周边防线。

lemmas.usage_note: 军事术语，指由数个班组成的“排”，由少尉或中尉指挥；引申指出动的一群或一组人，常与commander搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 platoon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the territorial jurisdiction of a bishop

examples.en: The bishop oversees more than fifty local parishes spread across the entire diocese.
examples.zh: 这位主教负责监管分布在整个教区内的五十多个地方堂区。

lemmas.usage_note: 宗教管理体制术语，指主教所管辖的教区；常与Catholic、Anglican连用，搭配动词administer或lead。

lemmas.def_en: belonging to or governing a diocese

examples.en: Representatives from every local parish attended the annual diocesan conference yesterday morning.
examples.zh: 昨天上午，来自当地各个教区的代表出席了一年一度的主教管区会议。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 diocese 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [I] (+ with/from) To shake slightly and uncontrollably because you are cold, frightened, or excited.

examples.en: A sudden gust of icy wind made the travelers shiver in their coats.
examples.zh: 一阵突如其来的冰冷寒风让旅行者们在外套里瑟瑟发抖。

lemmas.def_zh: 颤抖的, 令人悚然的, 寒冷的, 易碎的
lemmas.def_en: cold enough to cause shivers

examples.en: felt all shivery
shivery weather

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shiver 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 凉鞋, 拖鞋, 檀香木
lemmas.def_en: a shoe consisting of a sole fastened by straps to the foot

examples.en: She slipped on a comfortable pair of leather sandals before walking down to the beach.
examples.zh: 去海滩前，她穿上了一双舒适的皮凉鞋。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sandal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a digital camera designed to take digital photographs and transmit them over the internet

examples.en: Please make sure your webcam is turned on before the video interview begins.
examples.zh: 视频面试开始前，请确保网络摄像头已开启。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 webcam 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 地志, 地形学, 地势, 局部解剖学
lemmas.def_en: the configuration of a surface and the relations among its man-made and natural features

examples.en: The rugged topography of the island makes road construction extremely challenging and expensive.
examples.zh: 该岛崎岖的地形使道路修建变得极其困难且昂贵。

lemmas.def_en: concerned with topography

examples.en: a topographical engineer
a topographical survey

lemmas.def_zh: 地形的, 地形学的, 地形测量的
lemmas.def_en: concerned with topography

examples.en: a topographical engineer
a topographical survey

lemmas.def_zh: 从地形上；在地形构造方面
lemmas.def_en: with regard to topography

examples.en: the geological environment is the primary factor in determining the character of a country not only topographically but historically

family_guide.root_logic: 以 topography 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 美人鱼, 善泳的女子
lemmas.def_en: half woman and half fish; lives in the sea

examples.en: Local folklore tells of a lonely mermaid who guided lost sailors safely home.
examples.zh: 当地民间传说讲的是一条引导迷航水手平安返家的孤独美人鱼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mermaid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a route shorter than the usual one

examples.en: We took a narrow shortcut through the park to avoid the heavy evening traffic.
examples.zh: 我们抄了一条穿过公园的近道，以避开傍晚拥堵的交通。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shortcut 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a holder or proprietor of land

examples.en: The wealthy landowner decided to preserve the vast forest instead of selling it off.
examples.zh: 这位富有的土地所有者决定保护这片大森林，而不是将其卖掉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 landowner 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a clergyman or other person in religious orders

examples.en: The village cleric offered comfort and guidance to the grieving family after the tragedy.
examples.zh: 悲剧发生后，村里的神职人员为悲痛的家庭提供了安慰与引导。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cleric 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a junction of highways on different levels that permits traffic to move from one to another without crossing traffic streams

examples.en: The busy highway interchange was completely redesigned to improve safety and ease severe congestion.
examples.zh: 为了提高安全性并缓解严重拥堵，该繁忙的立交道进行了彻底改造。

lemmas.def_zh: （使）互相交换，互换位置；交替，轮换
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] to exchange things with each other, or alternate in sequence.

examples.en: The busy highway interchange was completely redesigned to improve safety and ease severe congestion.
examples.zh: 为了提高安全性并缓解严重拥堵，该繁忙的立交道进行了彻底改造。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 interchange 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a symptom consisting of the involuntary expulsion of air from the nose

examples.en: Dust from the old books caused him to sneeze uncontrollably in the library.
examples.zh: 旧书上的灰尘让他在图书馆里忍不住连连打喷嚏。

lemmas.def_en: a person who sneezes
1. [I] To suddenly expel air noisily through your nose and mouth because of dust, allergies, or a cold.

examples.en: Dust from the old books caused him to sneeze uncontrollably in the library.
examples.zh: 旧书上的灰尘让他在图书馆里忍不住连连打喷嚏。

lemmas.def_zh: 老打喷嚏的, 引起喷嚏的
lemmas.def_en: inclined to sneeze

examples.en: The dusty basement made her eyes watery and her nose increasingly sneezy.
examples.zh: 布满灰尘的地下室让她泪流满面，喷嚏打个不停。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sneeze 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 松的, 不严格的, 腹泻的, 松弛的
lemmas.def_en: lacking in rigor or strictness

examples.en: The airline was heavily fined for its lax safety procedures.
examples.zh: 该航空公司因安全流程松懈而受到严厉处罚。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰security、discipline或attitude，表示“松懈的”或“不严格的”，多含贬义批评色彩。

lemmas.def_en: the condition of being physiologically lax

examples.en: baths can help the laxness of the bowels

lemmas.def_zh: 拉克斯内斯(①姓氏 ②HalldЕr Kiljan, 1902-, 冰岛作家, 曾获1955年诺贝尔文学奖)
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being lax and neglectful

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lax 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 改变……的形状或结构，重塑；翻新，改造
lemmas.def_en: [T] to change the structure, layout, or appearance of a building, room, or system.

examples.en: They decided to remodel the old kitchen to create more open living space.
examples.zh: 他们决定重新装修改建旧厨房，以营造更开阔的居住空间。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常与kitchen、house搭配指“翻新装修”，或接system、policy表示“结构性重塑”。

lemmas.def_zh: 重塑了，改造了（remodel 的过去式和过去分词）
lemmas.def_en: [T] (chiefly British English) past tense and past participle of remodel; altered the structure or appearance of.

family_guide.root_logic: 以 remodel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 鞭打，痛打；彻底击败；剧烈扭动，翻腾
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. [T] To hit or beat a person or animal repeatedly with a stick or whip. 2. [T] To decisively defeat an opponent. 3. [I] To flail or move limbs violently and wildly.

examples.en: The swimmer panicked and began to thrash about wildly in the deep water.
examples.zh: 游泳者惊慌失措，开始在深水区拼命扑腾挣扎。

lemmas.usage_note: 可用作及物或不及物动词，常与around搭配表示“剧烈扭动”，引申指在体育比赛中“彻底击败”对手。

lemmas.def_en: a farm machine for separating seeds or grain from the husks and straw

family_guide.root_logic: 以 thrash 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a part of the city far removed from the center

examples.en: They purchased a charming cottage on the southern outskirts of the city.
examples.zh: 他们在该市的南郊购买了一栋迷人的乡村小屋。

lemmas.usage_note: 郊区；市郊

family_guide.root_logic: 以 outskirt 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 小圆石, 小鹅卵石, 水晶透镜, 碎石花纹
lemmas.def_en: a small smooth rounded rock

examples.en: The boy picked up a smooth flat pebble and skipped it across the pond.
examples.zh: 小男孩捡起一块扁平光滑的鹅卵石，在池塘上打起了水漂。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指被水流打磨光滑的小卵石，常与beach或stream搭配，构成名词修饰语如pebble beach。

lemmas.def_zh: 多砾石的, 有碎石花纹的, 声音粗糙刺耳的
lemmas.def_en: abounding in small stones

examples.en: We walked barefoot along the pebbly beach, enjoying the cool morning sea breeze.
examples.zh: 我们光着脚走在多砾石的海滩上，享受清晨凉爽的海风。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pebble 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a melon vine of the genus Cucumis; cultivated from earliest times for its cylindrical green fruit

examples.en: Add some sliced cucumber to the salad to give it a fresh, crunchy texture.
examples.zh: 在沙拉里加入一些黄瓜切片，可以让口感更加清脆爽口。

lemmas.usage_note: 指蔬菜黄瓜，常见习语为as cool as a cucumber，形容人在高压下表现得极其冷静沉着。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cucumber 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: relatively small placental mammals having a single pair of constantly growing incisor teeth specialized for gnawing

examples.en: Mice and squirrels are common rodents that can cause damage to household insulation.
examples.zh: 老鼠和松鼠是常见的啮齿动物，可能会损坏房屋的隔热层。

lemmas.usage_note: 生物学及日常通用名词，统称老鼠、松鼠等啮齿类动物，常与pest control或infestation搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rodent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 青年招待所, 宿舍, 旅店
lemmas.def_en: a hotel providing overnight lodging for travelers

examples.en: During their backpacking trip across Europe, they stayed in a cheap hostel.
examples.zh: 在欧洲背包旅行期间，他们住在一间廉价的青年旅馆里。

lemmas.usage_note: 指青年旅舍或招待所，常与youth搭配构成youth hostel，多用于背包客及低预算旅游场景。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hostel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: knowledge gained through tradition or anecdote

examples.en: According to local lore, the ancient ruins in the forest are guarded by spirits.
examples.zh: 根据当地传说，森林中的古代遗迹由神灵守护着。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，指口头流传的特定领域民间传统知识、学问或奇闻，常作folk lore或local lore。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lore 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 附录, 附加物, 阑尾
lemmas.def_en: supplementary material that is collected and appended at the back of a book

examples.en: Detailed statistical data can be found in the appendix at the back of the book.
examples.zh: 详细的统计数据可以在书末的附录中找到。

lemmas.usage_note: 双重核心语义：学术书籍末尾的“附录”（复数可为appendices）或医学人体解剖的“阑尾”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 appendix 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 稀疏的, 稀稀落落的, 稀薄的
lemmas.def_en: not dense

examples.en: Vegetation becomes increasingly sparse as you climb higher up the rocky mountain.
examples.zh: 随着你向多石的高山上攀登，植被变得越来越稀疏。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰植被、人口或资源分布，多用于书面语，常见搭配为 sparse population 或 sparse vegetation。

lemmas.def_zh: 稀疏地; 稀少地; 不足地; 贫乏地
lemmas.def_en: in a sparse manner

examples.en: sparsely inhabited

lemmas.def_zh: 稀疏, 稀少, 贫乏
lemmas.def_en: the property of being scanty or scattered; lacking denseness
the property of being scanty or scattered; lacking denseness

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sparse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 溶解的, 可溶解的, 可以解决的
lemmas.def_en: (of a substance) capable of being dissolved in some solvent (usually water)

examples.en: Vitamin C is water-soluble, which means the body cannot store it for long periods.
examples.zh: 维生素C是水溶性的，这意味着人体无法长期储存它。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可指物质“可溶解的”（常与 in 连用），也可比喻问题“可解决的”，主要用于科技与正式语境。

lemmas.def_zh: 可溶性, 溶解度, 解决之可能性
lemmas.def_en: the quantity of a particular substance that can dissolve in a particular solvent (yielding a saturated solution)

family_guide.root_logic: 以 soluble 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an exploratory oil well drilled in land not known to be an oil field

examples.en: European wildcats are shy animals that prefer to live in dense and remote forests.
examples.zh: 欧洲野猫是一种胆怯的动物，更喜欢栖息在偏远茂密的森林中。

lemmas.usage_note: 指野生猫科动物，亦可借喻脾气暴躁凶悍的人；在财经或工业语境中还可表示野猫式勘探井。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wildcat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the outline of a coast

examples.en: The island features a dramatic, rocky coastline that attracts millions of tourists every year.
examples.zh: 该岛拥有引人注目的岩石海岸线，每年吸引数百万游客。

lemmas.usage_note: 指陆地与海洋交界的海岸线轮廓，常用 rugged、rocky 或 jagged 等形容词修饰，属于地理通用词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 coastline 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 耍弄，玩杂耍（抛接物体）；同时兼顾，巧妙应付
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To keep several objects in the air at the same time by tossing and catching them. 2. [T] To manage several activities, responsibilities, or requirements at the same time.

examples.en: Many working parents struggle to juggle demanding full-time jobs with child care responsibilities.
examples.zh: 许多职场父母都在努力兼顾要求苛刻的全职工作与照顾孩子的责任。

lemmas.usage_note: 本义为杂耍抛接；引申指艰难地同时兼顾多项事务（常与 with 连用）或篡改账目数据，口语及书面通用。

lemmas.def_en: a performer who juggles objects and performs tricks of manual dexterity

family_guide.root_logic: 以 juggle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: English writer of satirical novels (1917-1993)

examples.en: In medieval England, each chartered borough had the right to send a burgess to Parliament.
examples.zh: 在中世纪的英格兰，每个获得特许权的自治市都有权向议会派出一名代表市民。

lemmas.usage_note: 历史法律名词，专指英国古代自治镇的自由民或议会代表，通常出现于历史文献与政制史研究中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 burgess 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a pear-shaped tropical fruit with green or blackish skin and rich yellowish pulp enclosing a single large seed

examples.en: She spread mashed avocado on a slice of toasted sourdough bread for breakfast.
examples.zh: 她把捣碎的牛油果抹在一片烤酸面包上作为早餐。

lemmas.usage_note: 指牛油果（鳄梨）果实或果树，日常烹饪与饮食中极常用，常见搭配如 ripe avocado 或 avocado toast。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 avocado 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: excessively agitated; distraught with fear or other violent emotion

examples.en: Rescue workers made frantic efforts to find survivors trapped beneath the collapsed building.
examples.zh: 救援人员拼命搜寻被困在倒塌建筑物下的幸存者。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容因极度慌乱、焦虑或忙碌而手忙脚乱的状态，常搭配 frantic effort 或 frantic search。

lemmas.def_en: in an uncontrolled manner

examples.en: she fought back madly

family_guide.root_logic: 以 frantic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: constituting a separate entity or part

examples.en: The researcher divided the complex process into several discrete and manageable stages.
examples.zh: 研究人员将这个复杂的过程划分成了几个独立且易于管理的阶段。

lemmas.usage_note: 强调事物相互独立、不连续、有明确界限，多用于学术、数学（如 discrete data）或正式文体。

lemmas.def_en: the state of being several and distinct

family_guide.root_logic: 以 discrete 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 活力, 气力, 劲头, 锐气
lemmas.def_en: liveliness and energy

examples.en: The coach gave the players a passionate pep talk in the locker room right before the final match.
examples.zh: 决赛前，教练在更衣室里为队员们做了一番慷慨激昂的动员讲话。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式口语词，指活力、干劲与锐气，高频固定搭配有 pep rally（动员大会）及 pep talk（打气话）。

lemmas.def_zh: 精神充沛的, 活泼的, 起动快的
lemmas.def_en: marked by lively action

examples.en: a bouncing gait
bouncy tunes

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pep 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To deliberately avoid someone or something out of dislike, fear, or moral disapproval.

examples.en: After the scandal broke, she decided to shun public life and live quietly in the countryside.
examples.zh: 丑闻爆发后，她决定避开公众生活，在乡村过着平静的日子。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作及物动词，指有意避开某人、某地或恶习，常用于书面语，常见搭配如 shun publicity（避开公众关注）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shun 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (formal) To be next to or share a boundary or wall with a room, building, or piece of land.

examples.en: A spacious terrace adjoins the master bedroom, offering a panoramic view of the ocean.
examples.zh: 一个宽敞的露台与主卧相连，可将开阔的海景尽收眼底。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常作及物或不及物动词，指建筑物或土地紧挨毗连，多用于正式描写或地产法律语境中。

lemmas.def_en: joining; forming an adjunct

examples.en: The doctor prescribed gentle yoga as an adjunctive therapy alongside regular medication.
examples.zh: 除常规药物治疗外，医生还开出了温和的瑜伽作为辅助疗法。

lemmas.def_en: an act of joining or adjoining things

examples.en: The adjunction of fresh herbs enhanced the flavor of the otherwise simple broth.
examples.zh: 添加新鲜香草提升了原本平淡的肉汤的风味。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 adjoin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 全面翻修，改版，翻新；修补
lemmas.def_en: [T] To reorganize, repair, or redesign something thoroughly so as to improve its appearance or functioning.

examples.en: The company hired a new marketing team to completely revamp its outdated brand image.
examples.zh: 该公司聘请了一支新的营销团队，以彻底翻新其过时的品牌形象。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指对系统、外观或组织进行全面翻新或改造，常与 system、image、website 搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 revamp 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不道德的, 邪恶的, 放荡的
lemmas.def_en: deliberately violating accepted principles of right and wrong

examples.en: Profiteering from a public health crisis is widely regarded as utterly immoral.
examples.zh: 在公共卫生危机期间牟取暴利被普遍认为是极其不道德的。

lemmas.usage_note: 作形容词，修饰违背道德规范的行为或人，常与 behavior、act 或 conduct 等名词连用。

lemmas.def_zh: 不道德, 道德败坏, 不道德的行为, 伤风败俗的行为
lemmas.def_en: the quality of not being in accord with standards of right or good conduct

examples.en: the immorality of basing the defense of the West on the threat of mutual assured destruction

lemmas.def_zh: 淫荡地; 不正经地; 不道德地; 品行不良地
lemmas.def_en: without regard for morality

examples.en: he acted immorally when his own interests were at stake

family_guide.root_logic: 以 immoral 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 急救医士，急救护理人员
lemmas.def_en: a person trained to assist medical professionals and to give emergency medical treatment

examples.en: The paramedic administered emergency oxygen to the patient while speeding toward the hospital.
examples.zh: 急救人员在疾驰赶往医院的同时为病人输上了急救氧气。

lemmas.phonetic: 急救医士，急救护理人员
lemmas.usage_note: 急救医士，急救护理人员
lemmas.zh: 急救医士，急救护理人员

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 关系医学的, 与医学有关的
lemmas.def_en: a person trained to assist medical professionals and to give emergency medical treatment

family_guide.root_logic: 以 paramedic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 光子, 光量子, 光度
lemmas.def_en: a quantum of electromagnetic radiation; an elementary particle that is its own antiparticle

examples.en: Solar panels convert energy from each captured photon into usable electricity.
examples.zh: 太阳能电池板将捕获的每一个光子的能量转化为可用的电能。

lemmas.usage_note: 物理学专业可数名词，指光子，常与 emission（发射）、absorption（吸收）搭配使用于科技语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 photon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 颂歌, 咒语(尤指四吠陀经典内作为咒文或祷告唱念的)
lemmas.def_en: a commonly repeated word or phrase

examples.en: "Quality over quantity" has always been the guiding mantra of this artisanal bakery.
examples.zh: “质量重于数量”一直是这家手作烘焙坊恪守的座右铭。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，原指宗教咒语，现多引申为组织或个人的座右铭、反复强调的行动口号，常作单数使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mantra 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 婴儿小床, 食槽, 蓄栏
lemmas.def_en: baby bed with high sides made of slats

examples.en: She gently laid the sleeping baby down into the wooden crib and pulled up the blanket.
examples.zh: 她轻轻地把熟睡的婴儿放到木质婴儿床里，并拉上了毯子。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，在美语中主要指带护栏的婴儿床，在俚语中也可指住所，常与 put in a crib 连用。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To copy someone else's written work, answers, or ideas dishonestly, especially in schoolwork or an exam.

examples.en: He was disqualified from the exam after the teacher caught him cribbing answers from his neighbor.
examples.zh: 他在考场上抄袭同桌的答案被老师抓住后，被取消了考试资格。

lemmas.usage_note: 作动词多为非正式用语，表示抄袭、剽窃（他人作业或文字），常搭配 crib from 或 crib notes。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crib 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a resentment strong enough to justify retaliation

examples.en: Life is too short to hold a grudge over such a trivial misunderstanding.
examples.zh: 人生苦短，没必要为了这样微不足道的误会而耿耿于怀。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指长期的怨恨或积怨，常与动词 bear、hold 或 harbor 连用，多用于日常及书面语境。

lemmas.def_zh: 心怀怨恨；勉强给予，吝惜；嫉妒
lemmas.def_en: [T] To feel resentful or bitter about giving, allowing, or seeing someone enjoy something.

examples.en: Nobody could grudge him his well-deserved success after years of tireless dedication.
examples.zh: 在经历了多年的不懈奉献之后，没人会嫉妒他应得的成功。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常接双宾语（grudge sb sth）或动名词，表示对给予某物感到不情愿、吝惜或嫉妒。

lemmas.def_en: in a grudging manner

examples.en: he grudgingly agreed to have a drink in a hotel close by

lemmas.def_en: given, granted, or allowed only reluctantly or resentfully
lemmas.usage_note: 常与 respect, admiration, acceptance, praise 等抽象名词搭配，表示“勉强给予”。

examples.en: Even his toughest critics gave him grudging respect for his achievement.
examples.zh: 连对他最严苛的批评者也不得不对他的成就表示勉强的钦佩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 grudge 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 苍翠繁茂的, 多青草的, 丰富的
lemmas.def_en: produced or growing in extreme abundance

examples.en: The valley was covered in lush green meadows after the abundant spring rains.
examples.zh: 充沛的春雨过后，山谷里覆盖着苍翠繁茂的绿色草甸。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，常修饰植物生长茂密、土地肥沃，亦可形容环境奢华，常见搭配如 lush vegetation、lush garden。

lemmas.def_en: the property of being lush and abundant and a pleasure to the senses

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lush 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To clean or wash a floor or surface using a mop; wipe away sweat or liquid.

examples.en: He used an old towel to mop the sweat from his forehead after the run.
examples.zh: 跑步结束后，他用一条旧毛巾擦掉了额头上的汗水。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与 up 搭配，既可指物理上的“拖地、擦汗”，也可引申表示扫尾、肃清残敌。

lemmas.def_en: a worker who uses a mop to clean a surface

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mop 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a collection of selected literary passages

examples.en: The publisher just released a comprehensive anthology of contemporary American poetry.
examples.zh: 出版商刚刚推出了一部当代美国诗歌的精选集。

lemmas.usage_note: 指由多位作家作品汇编而成的文集或诗选，常用搭配为 an anthology of poetry/stories。

lemmas.def_en: an editor who makes selections for an anthology

family_guide.root_logic: 以 anthology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 消除威胁，制服；抵消，使中和；使中立化
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To stop an enemy, threat, poison, or weapon from being dangerous or having an effect. 2. [T] To counteract something so that it has no effect. 3. [T] To declare a country or area politically neutral.

examples.en: Adding baking soda will quickly neutralize the acid in the spilled solution.
examples.zh: 加入小苏打可以迅速中和洒出的溶液中的酸性成分。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于化学（中和酸碱）、军事（消灭威胁）或政治商业（抵消负面影响）语境。

lemmas.def_zh: 抵消，使中和；使失效，解除威胁
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (British English) To stop something from having any effect or causing damage; to counteract or neutralize.

examples.en: The mafia liquidated the informer
the double agent was neutralized

lemmas.def_zh: 中立化, 中立状态, 中和
lemmas.def_en: action intended to keep a country politically neutral or exclude it from a possible war

examples.en: the neutralization of Belgium

family_guide.root_logic: 以 neutralize 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 犹太人集会, 犹太教会堂, 犹太教
lemmas.def_en: (Judaism) the place of worship for a Jewish congregation

examples.en: Families gathered at the local synagogue on Saturday morning for worship.
examples.zh: 周六早晨，各家各户聚集在当地的犹太会堂进行礼拜。

lemmas.usage_note: 专指犹太人礼拜与聚会的犹太会堂，常与 attend 或 go to 连用，多作可数名词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 synagogue 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (of a train) To run off its tracks, or cause a train to do this. 2. [T] To obstruct, spoil, or prevent a plan or process from continuing successfully.

examples.en: A sudden budget cut threatens to derail the entire infrastructure project.
examples.zh: 突如其来的预算削减可能会彻底破坏这整个基建项目。

lemmas.usage_note: 可作及物或不及物动词，既指火车出轨，更常引申指破坏、阻碍谈判或计划的进行。

lemmas.def_en: an accident in which a train runs off its track

family_guide.root_logic: 以 derail 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any plant of the genus Erica

examples.en: The rugged hillside was carpeted with blooming pink erica in early spring.
examples.zh: 早春时节，崎岖的山坡上铺满了盛开的粉色欧石南。

lemmas.usage_note: 植物学及园艺学常用名词，专指欧石南属灌木，常作可数或不可数名词使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 erica 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of several psychotic disorders characterized by distortions of reality and disturbances of thought and language and withdrawal from social contact

examples.en: Early diagnosis and ongoing treatment are crucial for patients living with schizophrenia.
examples.zh: 早期诊断和持续治疗对于精神分裂症患者而言至关重要。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学上指精神分裂症，日常比喻中可指态度、政策等严重自相矛盾、分裂的状态。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 精神分裂症的, 精神分裂症患者
lemmas.def_en: someone who is afflicted with schizophrenia

examples.en: The facility provides specialized residential care for diagnosed schizophrenics.
examples.zh: 该机构为确诊的精神分裂症患者提供专门的住院护理。

lemmas.usage_note: 指患有精神分裂症的人，因存在标签化倾向，正式语境更推荐用 person with schizophrenia。

lemmas.def_en: suffering from some form of schizophrenia

examples.en: The government's schizophrenic economic policy has confused both investors and consumers.
examples.zh: 政府前后矛盾的经济政策让投资者和消费者都感到无所适从。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指精神分裂症的，也常在非正式语境中形容行为、政策“前后矛盾的、分裂的”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 schizophrenia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or used in cooking

examples.en: She decided to enroll in a prestigious French culinary school to improve her cooking.
examples.zh: 她决定进入一所享有盛誉的法国烹饪学校以提升厨艺。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰技能、传统或艺术，典型搭配包括 culinary skills、culinary arts 与 culinary delights。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 culinary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the use of chemical agents to treat or control disease (or mental illness)

examples.en: The cancer patient is scheduled to undergo six rounds of chemotherapy.
examples.zh: 这名癌症患者按计划将接受六个疗程的化学疗法。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学专有名词，常与 undergo、receive 搭配，日常口语中常简称为 chemo。

lemmas.def_zh: 化学疗法, 化学治疗
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to chemotherapy

examples.en: Doctors administered a new chemotherapeutic drug to slow the spread of the tumor.
examples.zh: 医生使用了一种新型化疗药物来减缓肿瘤的扩散。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chemotherapy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the body of individuals who manage businesses

examples.en: A delegation of influential businessmen met with local officials to discuss trade opportunities.
examples.zh: 一个由有影响力的商界人士组成的代表团会见了当地官员，探讨贸易机会。

lemmas.usage_note: businessman 的复数形式，泛指从事商业活动的男性群体；现代语境更提倡中性词 businesspeople。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 businessmen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the time you go to bed

examples.en: It is way past your bedtime, so turn off the computer and go to sleep.
examples.zh: 早就过了你的睡觉时间了，快关掉电脑去睡觉。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作不可数名词表示睡觉时间，多用于固定搭配如 bedtime story（睡前故事）或 past one's bedtime。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bedtime 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a member of an irregular armed force that fights a stronger force by sabotage and harassment

examples.en: The guerrillas launched a surprise attack on the military convoy before retreating into the jungle.
examples.zh: 游击队员对军方车队发动了突袭，随后撤回了丛林深处。

lemmas.usage_note: 指游击队员或游击队组织，常作可数名词，在军事与冲突语境中多与 rebel、fighter 等词连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 guerrilla 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 有利益的, 获利的, 合算的
lemmas.def_en: producing a sizeable profit

examples.en: The software engineer turned down several lucrative job offers to start her own venture.
examples.zh: 这位软件工程师拒绝了多份薪酬丰厚的工作邀约，选择自主创业。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容能够产生巨大利润的事物，常修饰 business、deal、market 或 career 等商业类名词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lucrative 为核心的派生词族。

examples.en: The mayor resigned amidst growing allegations of corruption within the city council.
examples.zh: 在市议会内部日益发酵的腐败指控声中，市长递交了辞呈。

lemmas.usage_note: 介词，多见于书面语或新闻报道，常接 chaos、controversy 或 noise 等表示混杂环境或气氛的抽象名词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 amidst 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 水边, 滨水区, 滩, 海滨, 江边
lemmas.def_en: the area of a city (such as a harbor or dockyard) alongside a body of water

examples.en: The city renovated the abandoned waterfront into a vibrant public park with scenic walkways.
examples.zh: 该市将废弃的滨水区改建成了一个带有观光步道的活力公共公园。

lemmas.usage_note: 指紧邻江河湖海的滨水地带，常以单数形式出现，多与 on/along the waterfront 等介词短语搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 waterfront 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (slang or dated) To understand or grasp something clearly.

examples.en: Keep quiet about this deal until the paperwork is signed, savvy?
examples.zh: 在合同签署之前对此事保持沉默，明白了吗？

lemmas.usage_note: 动词多用于非正式口语或俚语，意为“明白，懂得”，常见于句尾反问（如 Savvy?）或跟宾语从句。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 savvy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: transmission that combine media of communication (text and graphics and sound etc.)

examples.en: Modern classroom education relies heavily on multimedia to keep students engaged.
examples.zh: 现代课堂教学极大地依赖多媒体来保持学生的专注度。

lemmas.usage_note: 指结合声音、图像和文字的“多媒体”技术或应用形式，通常作不可数名词，多见于科技与教育领域。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 multimedia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 多国的, 跨国公司的
lemmas.def_en: involving or operating in several nations or nationalities

examples.en: She works as a financial analyst for a large multinational pharmaceutical company.
examples.zh: 她在一所大型跨国制药公司担任财务分析师。

lemmas.usage_note: 用于形容跨国经营或由多国组成的机构，常见搭配包括 multinational corporation（跨国公司）或 multinational force。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 multinational 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: toward the source or against the current

examples.en: Every autumn, millions of salmon swim upstream to reach their spawning grounds.
examples.zh: 每年秋天，数以百万计的鲑鱼逆流而上，前往它们的产卵地。

lemmas.usage_note: 副词，用来修饰 move、swim、travel 等动词，意为“逆流而上”或向河流上游方向移动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 upstream 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: in a manner differing from the usual or expected

examples.en: Oddly enough, nobody in the packed room seemed to notice the loud alarm going off.
examples.zh: 说来奇怪，拥挤的房间里似乎没有一个人注意到响起的巨大警报声。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰形容词或动词表示举止、外观怪异，亦可置于句首或句中作评注性状语，如 oddly enough（说来奇怪）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 oddly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a soft silver-white univalent element of the alkali metal group; the lightest metal known; occurs in several minerals

examples.en: The global transition to electric vehicles has driven an unprecedented surge in the demand for lithium.
examples.zh: 全球向电动汽车的转型推动了对锂需求的空前激增。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，常用于能源科技或医学领域，常见搭配有 lithium battery（锂电池）、lithium therapy 等。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lithium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: ceramic ware made of a more or less translucent ceramic
