examples.en: The museum holds an extraordinary collection of blue-and-white porcelain dating back to the Ming Dynasty.
examples.zh: 该博物馆收藏了一批极为珍贵的明代青花瓷器。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作不可数名词指瓷料或瓷器总称，用于艺术品或高档餐具，常见搭配有 fine porcelain、blue-and-white porcelain。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 porcelain 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 颤抖，战栗，发抖；摇晃，晃动
lemmas.def_en: [I] (+ with/at) To shake slightly and uncontrollably because you are cold, frightened, or emotionally excited; to shake slightly (of the ground or leaves).

examples.en: Her hands began to tremble with rage as she read the insulting letter.
examples.zh: 读到那封侮辱性的信件时，她的双手因愤怒而颤抖起来。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用作不及物动词，描述因寒冷、恐惧或激动而颤抖，常与介词 with 或 at 连用，语体较生动。

lemmas.def_zh: 发抖的人, 震颤的东西, 自动振动器, 蜂鸣器, 断续器, 电铃
lemmas.def_en: one who quakes and trembles with (or as with) fear
shaking or quivering slightly, typically as a result of anxiety, excitement, or cold
lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰手、身体、声音等因恐惧、寒冷或激动而产生的微小晃动。

examples.en: She opened the test results with trembling hands.
examples.zh: 她用颤抖的双手拆开了考试成绩单。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tremble 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 沉着的, 镇静的, 安静的
lemmas.def_en: characterized by dignity and propriety

examples.en: Retirement allowed him to trade his frantic schedule for a far more sedate pace of life.
examples.zh: 退休使他摆脱了忙乱的日程，转而过上了从容平缓得多的生活。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面语形容词，修饰生活方式、步伐或人的举止，常与 pace, lifestyle, manner 搭配，表示从容不迫。

lemmas.def_en: a drug that reduces excitability and calms a person
a state of reduced excitement or anxiety that is induced by the administrative of a sedative agent
[T] to give a patient or animal drugs to make them calm, sleepy, or unconscious.

examples.en: The veterinary surgeon had to heavily sedate the injured tiger before examining its wound.
examples.zh: 兽医在检查受伤老虎的伤口前，必须对其施用大剂量的镇静剂。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，属医学专业用语，指使用药物使病人安静或昏睡，常用于被动语态或带有副词 heavily 修饰。

lemmas.def_en: in a sedate manner

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sedate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: not genuine; imitating something superior

examples.en: Customs officials seized thousands of counterfeit designer watches at the port yesterday.
examples.zh: 海关官员昨日在港口查获了数千块假冒名牌手表。

lemmas.usage_note: 修饰名词，指伪造或仿造的货币、护照或商品，常见搭配 counterfeit money/notes, counterfeit goods。

lemmas.def_zh: 伪造，仿造；假装，假装具有
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To make an exact illegal copy of money, documents, or goods in order to deceive. 2. [T] (formal) To feign or pretend to have a feeling or quality.

examples.en: The criminal syndicate used advanced printing technology to counterfeit high-denomination currency.
examples.zh: 该犯罪团伙利用先进的印刷技术仿造大面额货币。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指非法仿制有价值之物以牟利，亦可指假装情感，常接 currency, documents 或 feelings 作宾语。

lemmas.def_zh: 伪造者, 货币伪造者, 假造者
lemmas.def_en: someone who makes copies illegally

family_guide.root_logic: 以 counterfeit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使变甜，加糖于；使更具吸引力，使变温和；变甜
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To make food, drink, or substances sweeter by adding sugar or sweetener, or to become sweet. 2. [T] To make a deal, offer, or condition more attractive or favorable.

examples.en: The company added extra stock options to sweeten the deal for the prospective executive.
examples.zh: 公司增加了额外的股票期权，以增加条件吸引这位未来的高管。

lemmas.usage_note: 可作及物或不及物动词，字面指加糖增甜，引申指改善条件以增加吸引力，常见搭配 sweeten the deal/pot。

lemmas.def_en: something added to foods to make them taste sweeter
not made sweet

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sweeten 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a sharp blow

examples.en: With a quick swat of the newspaper, he knocked the persistent wasp off the windowpane.
examples.zh: 他用报纸猛地一拍，把那只缠人的黄蜂从窗玻璃上拍了下来。

lemmas.usage_note: 猛击，重拍

lemmas.def_en: an implement with a flat part (of mesh or plastic) and a long handle; used to kill insects
[T] to hit something, especially an insect, with a sharp, flat blow.

examples.en: She sat on the porch, repeatedly swatting away the mosquitoes buzzing around her ears.
examples.zh: 她坐在门廊上，不停地拍打着在耳边嗡嗡作响的蚊子。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物或不及物动词，常指用力拍打昆虫，常见搭配有 swat away, swat at，口语色彩鲜明、动作感强。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 swat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 仁慈的, 宽厚的, 温和的
lemmas.def_en: (of weather or climate) physically mild

examples.en: The sailors were fortunate to embark on their voyage under unusually clement weather conditions.
examples.zh: 水手们很幸运，在异常温和的气候条件下开启了航程。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面语，多用来形容气候温和宜人（如 clement weather），亦可指统治者或法官仁慈宽厚。

lemmas.def_zh: 仁慈, 宽厚, 仁厚
lemmas.def_en: good weather with comfortable temperatures

family_guide.root_logic: 以 clement 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 间歇的, 断断续续的
lemmas.def_en: stopping and starting at irregular intervals

examples.en: Many people have adopted intermittent fasting as a sustainable method to manage their health.
examples.zh: 许多人已将间歇性禁食作为一种管理健康的可持续方法。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式用语，形容事物时断时续、间歇发生，常修饰 rain, fasting, bursts, pain 等名词。

lemmas.def_en: in an intermittent manner

examples.en: intermittently we questioned the barometer

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being intermittent; subject to interruption or periodic stopping

family_guide.root_logic: 以 intermittent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: conveyance consisting of a wheeled support on which a camera can be mounted

examples.en: The camera crew set up the dolly on the tracks to capture a smooth tracking shot.
examples.zh: 摄像组将移动车架在轨道上，以便拍摄流畅的移动镜头。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，口语指玩偶；影视及物流专业语境中常指摄影移动车或带轮搬运手推车（camera dolly, hand dolly）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dolly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 费力搬运，负重转移；使弓起
lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. (informal) To carry or lift something heavy with great effort. 2. To bend into a hump or curve.

examples.en: The cat humped its back and hissed fiercely at the barking dog.
examples.zh: 那只猫弓起背，对着狂吠的狗发出凶狠的嘶嘶声。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作及物动词表示“使弓起（背部）”或英式口语中“费力搬运”，不及物动词可指急行或努力工作。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hump 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 下放（权力、职责等）；移交；退化
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] (+ to/upon) To transfer power, authority, or responsibility from a central organization or government to a local or lower level.

examples.en: The central government agreed to devolve more budgetary control to regional authorities.
examples.zh: 中央政府同意将更多的预算控制权下放给地方政府。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式政治与管理语体，常用搭配 devolve power/responsibility to/upon 表示“下放权力或职责”。

lemmas.def_zh: 相传, 转让, 委付
lemmas.def_en: the process of declining from a higher to a lower level of effective power or vitality or essential quality

family_guide.root_logic: 以 devolve 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: failure that results in a loss of position or reputation

examples.en: Unchecked arrogance and economic crisis ultimately led to the tyrant's downfall.
examples.zh: 不受节制的傲慢和经济危机最终导致了这位暴君的垮台。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指帝国、政治人物或事业的“衰败、垮台”，常与 lead to 或 cause 连用；少见指暴雨。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 downfall 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 严峻的, 禁欲的, 简朴的
lemmas.def_en: severely simple

examples.en: The monks led an austere lifestyle, dedicating their days to silent prayer and manual labor.
examples.zh: 僧侣们过着极其清苦禁欲的生活，整日专注于默祷和体力劳动。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面语，可修饰生活方式（禁欲简朴）、外表或态度（严厉严肃）及建筑风格（朴素无华）。

lemmas.def_zh: 朴素, 苦行, 严格, 严峻
lemmas.def_en: the trait of great self-denial (especially refraining from worldly pleasures)
in an austere fashion

examples.en: the church was austerely simple

family_guide.root_logic: 以 austere 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: nonresinous wood of a fir tree

examples.en: The mountain slopes were thickly covered with majestic Douglas firs.
examples.zh: 山坡上密密麻麻地覆盖着巍峨的道格拉斯冷杉。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词指“冷杉树、枞树”，不可数名词指其木材，常用于 fir tree 或与圣诞树相关的语境中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fir 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 用门闩闩牢，上闩；抓住，理解（latch onto）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To fasten a door, gate, or window with a latch, or to be fastened in this way. 2. [I] ('latch onto') To attach oneself to someone, or to grasp an idea eagerly.

examples.en: Make sure you latch the front gate properly so the dog doesn't escape.
examples.zh: 一定要把前门闩好，免得狗跑出去。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可指关门并“上闩/闩牢”，也常构成习语 latch onto，表示“抓住、理解”或“缠住某人”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 latch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of the numerous plants of the genus Viola

examples.en: She switched from the violin to the viola because she loved its deeper, warmer tone.
examples.zh: 她从小提琴改学中提琴，因为她更喜欢中提琴那深沉温厚的音色。

lemmas.usage_note: 专指西洋弦乐器中的“中提琴”，常与 play 搭配，置于定冠词 the 之后表示演奏该乐器。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 viola 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (law) an explanation of the fundamental reasons (especially an explanation of the working of some device in terms of laws of nature)

examples.en: The board requested a detailed rationale behind the proposed corporate restructuring.
examples.zh: 董事会要求对拟议的公司重组方案提供详细的基本依据。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式用语，表示某决定或行动的“根本逻辑、基本依据”，常与 for 或 behind 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rationale 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the number that is represented as a one followed by 7 zeros; ten million

examples.en: The infrastructure project is estimated to cost more than fifty crore rupees.
examples.zh: 该基础设施项目的造价预计将超过五亿（五十个克罗）卢比。

lemmas.usage_note: 南亚英语专属数词名词，表示“一千万”，前面接具体数字时不加 -s，常用于描述卢比金额或人口。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crore 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a skilled worker who practices some trade or handicraft

examples.en: Local artisans gathered at the cultural fair to demonstrate their traditional pottery techniques.
examples.zh: 当地手艺人们齐聚文化博览会，现场展示传统的制陶技艺。

lemmas.usage_note: 指具备高超手工艺技能的“手艺人、工匠”，常用于强调手工制作传统或与现代工业流水线对比。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 artisan 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 塞入，塞满，填满；（考前）突击死记硬背
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (+ into) To push or force people or things into a small space until it is completely full. 2. [I] (+ for) (informal) To study intensively in a short period of time, especially right before an examination.

examples.en: She managed to cram all her winter clothes into a single suitcase before leaving.
examples.zh: 临行前，她设法把所有的冬衣都硬塞进了一只手提箱里。

lemmas.usage_note: 常搭配 cram into/with 表示硬塞进狭小空间；也可指考前临时抱佛脚，常用 cram for an exam。

lemmas.def_zh: 搞填鸭式教学的教师, 谎言
lemmas.def_en: a student who crams

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cram 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a pair of loose trousers tied by a drawstring around the waist; worn by men and women in some Asian countries

examples.en: He put on a pair of silk pajamas and read a book in bed until he fell asleep.
examples.zh: 他穿上一套真丝睡衣，在床上看书直到睡着。

lemmas.usage_note: 指成套的宽松睡衣裤；美式拼作 pajama，英式常用 pyjama，通常以复数形式 pajamas 出现。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pajama 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 严重损毁，毁损；残害，使残废；使残缺不全
lemmas.def_en: [T] to damage an object, body, or text severely by cutting, tearing, or destroying essential parts.

examples.en: Vandals entered the gallery overnight and managed to mutilate several priceless paintings.
examples.zh: 暴徒在夜间闯入画廊，肆意毁损了数幅无价名画。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指严重毁损肢体致残，或严重破坏文本、艺术品等，带有强烈的暴烈或破坏色彩。

lemmas.def_en: an injury that causes disfigurement or that deprives you of a limb or other important body part
a person who mutilates or destroys or disfigures or cripples

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mutilate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: excluded from use or mention

examples.en: In many cultures, discussing personal finances openly remains a taboo subject.
examples.zh: 在许多文化中，公开讨论个人财务状况仍然是一个禁忌话题。

lemmas.usage_note: 作形容词表示因社会习俗或宗教信仰而受禁忌的，常作表语或定语，搭配 a taboo subject。

lemmas.def_en: [T] to forbid or ban a topic, word, or practice by social convention or religious custom.

examples.en: Ancient tribal customs strictly tabooed the hunting of certain sacred animals in this forest.
examples.zh: 古老的部落习俗严禁在这片森林里捕猎某些神圣动物。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，正式用法，指将某事物列为禁忌或予以禁止，多用于文化、人类学或法律语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 taboo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a large bomb used to demolish extensive areas (as a city block)

examples.en: During World War II, the air force dropped a powerful blockbuster that flattened an entire factory.
examples.zh: 在二战期间，空军投下一枚巨型重磅炸弹，将整座工厂夷为平地。

lemmas.usage_note: 本义指二战时的大型重磅炸弹；现多喻指极具轰动效应且票房极高的大片或畅销大作。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 blockbuster 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: venomous Asiatic and African elapid snakes that can expand the skin of the neck into a hood

examples.en: The snake charmer played his flute as the hooded cobra rose slowly from the basket.
examples.zh: 弄蛇人吹起笛子，那条张开颈肋的眼镜蛇便从竹篓中缓缓立起。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指热带或亚热带剧毒眼镜蛇，常见搭配有 king cobra（眼镜王蛇）或 cobra venom。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cobra 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [I] To feel a strong, deep, and often wistful desire or longing for someone or something.

examples.en: After years in the noisy city, she began to yearn for the quiet simplicity of rural life.
examples.zh: 在喧嚣的城市生活多年后，她开始渴望乡村生活的宁静与纯朴。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示怀有强烈而持久的思念或渴望，书面语色彩浓厚，常接不定式 yearn to do 或介词 yearn for。

lemmas.def_zh: 渴望, 热望, 怀念
lemmas.def_en: prolonged unfulfilled desire or need

examples.en: A deep yearning for his lost homeland filled him with sorrow whenever he heard folk songs.
examples.zh: 每当听到民歌，他对失去的故土深切的怀恋便让他心中充满悲伤。

lemmas.usage_note: 指内心深处的强烈渴望或怀恋之情，常与介词 for 搭配，构成 have a yearning for something。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 yearn 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (formal) To praise someone or something lavishly or publicly.

examples.en: Critics and audiences alike continue to laud the director for her bold and innovative storytelling.
examples.zh: 评论家和观众都持续赞扬这位导演大胆而创新的叙事手法。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面语，指公开高度赞扬、称颂某人或某事，常搭配 laud somebody for something 或用于被动语态。

lemmas.def_zh: 瞒汇漏税；洗矿槽（流槽, 出铁槽, 槽洗机）
lemmas.def_en: Scottish ballad singer and music hall comedian (1870-1950)

lemmas.def_zh: 值得赞赏的, 值得佩服的
lemmas.def_en: worthy of high praise

examples.en: applaudable efforts to save the environment
a commendable sense of purpose

lemmas.def_en: full of or giving praise

examples.en: The critic wrote a laudatory review praising the director's bold new vision.
examples.zh: 评论家写了一篇赞赏性的评论，盛赞这位导演大胆的新构想。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 laud 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a broad highway designed for high-speed traffic

examples.en: Traffic was brought to a standstill on the motorway due to a severe multi-car collision.
examples.zh: 由于发生严重的多车相撞事故，高速公路上的交通陷入瘫痪。

lemmas.usage_note: 英式英语核心词汇，指专供机动车高速行驶的封闭公路（美式对应 highway/freeway），常接介词 on。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 motorway 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使改道，使改变方向；转移（精力、资源等）；改寄（邮件）
lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. To send someone or something in a different direction or toward a new goal. 2. To arrange for mail or digital traffic to be sent to a new address.

examples.en: The police had to redirect all northbound traffic onto secondary roads because of the flood.
examples.zh: 由于发生洪水，警方不得不将所有北向通行的车辆改道至次级公路。

lemmas.usage_note: 指改变人员、资金、路线或信件等的去向与目标，常与介词 to 或 into 连用，构成 redirect... to...。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 redirect 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 辱骂，粗话痛骂；用俚语说
lemmas.def_en: [T] (British informal) To attack or insult someone using abusive, vulgar language.

examples.en: The two drivers stood in the middle of the road, slanging each other furiously after the minor collision.
examples.zh: 轻微碰撞之后，两位司机站在马路中间怒不可遏地对骂。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作及物或不及物动词，表示用粗话辱骂或大声斥责，口语色彩浓厚，常见于激烈争吵语境。

lemmas.def_en: constituting or expressed in slang or given to the use of slang

examples.en: a slangy expression
slangy speech

family_guide.root_logic: 以 slang 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 产生幻觉，出现幻觉；在幻觉中看到（或听到、感到）
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To see, hear, or feel things that are not really there, especially because of illness or drugs.

examples.en: After three days without sleep, the exhausted hiker began to hallucinate strange figures among the trees.
examples.zh: 连续三天没合眼后，疲惫不堪的徒步者开始产生幻觉，觉得树林里有怪异的人影。

lemmas.usage_note: 多作不及物动词表自主产生幻觉，作及物动词时表产生特定幻象，常用于医学或精神状态描述。

lemmas.def_en: illusory perception; a common symptom of severe mental disorder

lemmas.def_zh: 幻觉的, 引起幻觉的
lemmas.def_en: characterized by or characteristic of hallucination ; - Jean Stafford

examples.en: High fever induced strange hallucinatory visions throughout the restless night.
examples.zh: 高烧让他在辗转反侧的整夜里产生了奇异的幻觉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hallucinate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 用核武器摧毁，彻底消灭；用微波炉加热
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (informal) To attack or completely destroy something with nuclear weapons. 2. [T] (informal) To heat or cook food in a microwave oven.

examples.en: The director decided to nuke the entire marketing campaign after the disastrous initial feedback.
examples.zh: 在收到灾难性的初步反馈后，主管决定彻底推翻整个营销方案。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，既指用核武器攻击，也常引申为用微波炉加热或彻底摧毁、抹除某物，属非正式口语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nuke 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (+ into/away) To attract or persuade someone to do something by offering something pleasant or advantageous.

examples.en: The tech firm offered high signing bonuses to entice top engineers away from its competitors.
examples.zh: 这家科技公司提供丰厚的签约奖金，以诱使顶尖工程师离开竞争对手跳槽过来。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常搭配 entice sb into doing sth 或 entice sb away，强调通过利益诱导或吸引。

lemmas.def_en: something that seduces or has the quality to seduce

family_guide.root_logic: 以 entice 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (formal or technical) To take food, liquid, or medicine into the body by swallowing or absorbing it. 2. [T] (technical) To take in or assimilate data or information.

examples.en: Children may suffer serious health risks if they accidentally ingest small button batteries.
examples.zh: 儿童如果不慎吞食纽扣电池，可能会面临严重的健康风险。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，多用于医学、生物学或正式书面语，指吞下食物、药物或毒物，亦可比喻吸收信息。

lemmas.def_en: the process of taking food into the body through the mouth (as by eating)

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ingest 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: as known or named at another time or place

examples.en: The suspect was identified as Arthur Jones, alias 'The Shadow', by the international police.
examples.zh: 国际警方确认该嫌疑人为阿瑟·琼斯，又名“暗影”。

lemmas.usage_note: 常置于两个名字之间连接本名与别名，意为“又名”或“化名”，常用于警方通报或法律文书。

lemmas.def_en: a name that has been assumed temporarily

examples.en: The secret agent used a clever alias to book the hotel room without raising any suspicion.
examples.zh: 这名特工使用了一个巧妙的化名来预订酒店房间，没有引起任何怀疑。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指为掩盖真实身份使用的化名或假名，常用搭配有 operate under an alias。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 alias 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a large elongated exocrine gland located behind the stomach; secretes pancreatic juice and insulin

examples.en: The doctor explained how insulin produced by the pancreas helps regulate blood sugar levels.
examples.zh: 医生解释了胰腺分泌的胰岛素是如何帮助调节血糖水平的。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学解剖名词，指分泌胰岛素和消化酶的胰腺，单复数同形或复数为 pancreases，属专业术语。

lemmas.def_en: of or involving the pancreas

examples.en: pancreatic cancer

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pancreas 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who offers opposition

examples.en: He proved to be a formidable adversary in the courtroom, winning nearly every argument.
examples.zh: 在法庭上他表现出是一个强大的对手，几乎赢下了每一次辩论。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指比赛、争论或战斗中的对手与敌手，书面色彩较强，常与 political 或 formidable 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 adversary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: betrayal of a trust

examples.en: The general was executed after his treachery was exposed to the rebel leaders.
examples.zh: 在对起义军领袖的背叛行径暴露后，这位将军被处决了。

lemmas.usage_note: 背叛；背信弃义

lemmas.def_zh: 不可信任的, 危险的, 背叛的, 不可靠的
lemmas.def_en: dangerously unstable and unpredictable

examples.en: treacherous winding roads
an unreliable trestle

lemmas.def_zh: 背信弃义地; 背叛地; 靠不住地; 危险地
lemmas.def_en: in a disloyal and faithless manner

examples.en: he behaved treacherously
his wife played him false

family_guide.root_logic: 以 treachery 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 朝圣, 漫游, 人生的一段经历
lemmas.def_en: a journey to a sacred place

examples.en: Thousands of rock fans make an annual pilgrimage to the legendary guitarist's birthplace.
examples.zh: 成千上万的摇滚乐迷每年都会前往这位传奇吉他手的出生地朝圣。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，常与 make 或 go on 搭配，既指前往圣地的朝圣之旅，也引申为怀着敬意的瞻仰之行。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pilgrimage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 重新界定，重新定义；改变……的性质或范围
lemmas.def_en: [T] To define again or differently; to change the nature, meaning, or boundaries of a concept, role, or standard.

examples.en: Technological advancements continue to redefine the way we communicate and work.
examples.zh: 技术的进步不断重新定义着我们的交流与工作方式。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于书面语及学术语境，表示更新概念或改变格局，常见搭配为 redefine the concept of 或 redefine one's role。

lemmas.def_en: the act of giving a new definition

examples.en: words like `conservative' require periodic redefinition
she provided a redefinition of his duties

family_guide.root_logic: 以 redefine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 有壳的, 声音沙哑的, 强壮的
lemmas.def_en: muscular and heavily built

examples.en: She answered the phone with a husky voice, having just woken up.
examples.zh: 她刚睡醒，用低沉沙哑的声音接了电话。

lemmas.usage_note: 用于形容人时表示高大健壮，形容嗓音时表示低沉沙哑，常与 voice、whisper、frame 搭配。

lemmas.def_zh: 强壮结实之人, 爱斯基摩人
lemmas.def_en: breed of heavy-coated Arctic sled dog

examples.en: The team of huskies pulled the heavy sled effortlessly across the snow.
examples.zh: 那队哈士奇轻松地拉着沉重的雪橇穿过了雪原。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常作可数名词，指哈士奇雪橇犬，亦可俚指身形魁梧结实的人，常用于日常口语。

lemmas.def_en: the property of being big and strong
in a hoarse or husky voice

examples.en: `Excuse me,' he said hoarsely

family_guide.root_logic: 以 husky 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a roll of hair brushed back from the forehead

examples.en: The angler spent the entire afternoon catching roach by the tranquil riverbank.
examples.zh: 钓客在宁静的河畔坐了一整个下午钓斜齿鳊。

lemmas.usage_note: 作名词可指欧洲淡水鱼“拟鲤（斜齿鳊）”，亦为美式口语中蟑螂（cockroach）的简写，多用单复数形式。

lemmas.def_zh: 剪短（马鬃使其直立）；剪平（头发等）；使拱起
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (chiefly North American) To cut a horse's mane very short so that it stands bristling upright. 2. [T] To arch or curve something upward.

examples.en: The groom decided to roach the horse's mane neatly before the competition.
examples.zh: 马夫决定在比赛前把这匹马的鬃毛剪齐成拱形短鬃。

lemmas.usage_note: 专业技术或马术动词，指将马鬃修剪得短而直立，或使物体边缘呈拱起、凹弧状，多用于特定行业。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 roach 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 单方面的, 单边的, 片面的
lemmas.def_en: involving only one part or side

examples.en: The government faced severe criticism after making a unilateral decision to cancel the contract.
examples.zh: 政府在单方面决定取消合同后遭到了严厉批评。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式的法律、政治与外交用语，表示单方面采取行动，常见搭配包括 unilateral decision、unilateral action、unilateral ceasefire。

lemmas.def_en: in a unilateral manner; by means of one part or party

examples.en: they worked out an agreement unilaterally

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unilateral 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 中国官话, 国语, 满清官吏, 柑橘
lemmas.def_en: shrub or small tree having flattened globose fruit with very sweet aromatic pulp and thin yellow-orange to flame-orange rind that is loose and easily removed; native to southeastern Asia

examples.en: He speaks fluent Mandarin after living in Beijing for more than five years.
examples.zh: 在北京生活了五年多之后，他能说一口流利的普通话。

lemmas.usage_note: 首字母大写时指普通话，小写时可指中国古官吏、高级官僚或柑橘，常作主语或宾语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mandarin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 支持，支撑；增强，加强，巩固
lemmas.def_en: [T] To improve, strengthen, or support something such as confidence, an argument, or a structure.

examples.en: The central bank introduced new policies to bolster consumer confidence.
examples.zh: 央行出台了新政策以提振消费者信心。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常用于政经和辩论语境，意为强化、支持，高频搭配为 bolster confidence、bolster the economy、bolster morale。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bolster 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 铲子, 锄, 铲刀, 黑桃
lemmas.def_en: a playing card in the major suit that has one or more black figures on it

examples.en: He grabbed a sharp spade from the garden shed to dig a planting hole.
examples.zh: 他从花园工具棚里拿了一把锋利的铁铲去挖种植坑。

lemmas.usage_note: 指用于挖掘的平头铁锹、铁铲，亦指扑克牌中的黑桃花色，常见短语有 call a spade a spade（直言不讳）。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To dig, cut, or turn over earth using a spade.

examples.en: We need to spade the garden beds thoroughly before planting the seeds.
examples.zh: 播种之前，我们需要彻底用铁锹翻整花园的苗床。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物或不及物动词，表示用锹挖掘、翻土或用铲子抹平，常用于园艺或农耕语境，常接 soil、earth。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 spade 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To pay back part of an amount someone has already paid for goods, services, or taxes.

examples.en: The dealership agreed to rebate two hundred dollars to buyers of electric vehicles.
examples.zh: 经销商同意向购买电动汽车的顾客返还两百美元。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常用于商业、财税语境，指退还部分款项或打折扣，宾语通常为税款或费用，可接 to sb.

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rebate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 混乱, 动荡, 骚乱, 紊流
lemmas.def_en: unstable flow of a liquid or gas

examples.en: The airplane encountered severe turbulence while flying over the mountain range.
examples.zh: 飞机在飞越山脉时遭遇了严重的颠簸气流。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，物理上指气流或水流的紊流，比喻上指社会或局势的动荡混乱，常搭配 severe turbulence、political turbulence。

lemmas.def_zh: 狂暴的, 骚乱的, 紊乱的
lemmas.def_en: characterized by unrest or disorder or insubordination

examples.en: The country went through a turbulent period of political and economic reform.
examples.zh: 该国经历了一段政治和经济改革的动荡时期。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，用于修饰时代、局势、水流或情感，表示狂暴的、动荡不安的，常见搭配为 turbulent times、turbulent seas、turbulent relationship。

lemmas.def_en: in a turbulent manner; with turbulence

examples.en: the river rolls turbulently boiling

family_guide.root_logic: 以 turbulence 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the middle of the gestation period

examples.en: The students are spending their weekend in the library studying for the chemistry midterm.
examples.zh: 学生们正在图书馆度过周末，为化学期中考试做准备。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，主要用于美式校园语境指期中考试，复数亦可指政界的中期选举（midterms），常搭配 take/pass a midterm。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 midterm 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a historic division of Ireland located in the northeastern part of the island; six of Ulster's nine counties are in Northern Ireland

examples.en: He wrapped himself in a heavy tweed ulster to brave the freezing winter wind.
examples.zh: 他裹上一件厚重的粗花呢宽长大衣，以抵御冬日的刺骨寒风。

lemmas.usage_note: 指一种厚重、常配有腰带的宽松长款男士大衣，具历史复古感，多见于文学作品或服饰文化描写中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ulster 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a light strong grey lustrous corrosion-resistant metallic element used in strong lightweight alloys (as for airplane parts); the main sources are rutile and ilmenite

examples.en: The frame of the aircraft is reinforced with lightweight titanium.
examples.zh: 该飞机的机身框架采用轻质钛金属进行了加固。

lemmas.usage_note: 作为不可数名词表示金属元素“钛”，常用于航空航天、医疗器械及工程技术等科技语境中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 titanium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: British dominion over India (1757-1947)

examples.en: Life in India changed dramatically during the decades of the British Raj.
examples.zh: 在英国殖民统治的数十年间，印度的生活发生了巨大变化。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常与定冠词连用并大写（the Raj），专指英国在印度的殖民统治期；亦可泛指政权，书面语体。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 raj 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: waste matter carried away in sewers or drains

examples.en: The plant was built to prevent raw sewage from flowing into the river.
examples.zh: 建造该工厂是为了防止未经处理的污水流入河中。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，常与 raw、untreated 搭配，多用于市政建设、环境保护和公共卫生领域。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sewage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 希腊语的第二十一个字母(Φ,φ)
lemmas.def_en: the 21st letter of the Greek alphabet

examples.en: In mathematics, the Greek letter phi often represents the golden ratio.
examples.zh: 在数学中，希腊字母phi常用来表示黄金分割率。

lemmas.usage_note: 专指希腊字母Φ/φ，常用于数学、物理学公式表示黄金分割率、磁通量等学术语境中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 phi 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a traditional Japanese system of unarmed combat; sharp blows and kicks are given to pressure-sensitive points on the body of the opponent

examples.en: She earned a black belt after practicing karate for over ten years.
examples.zh: 她在练习空手道十余年后获得了黑带资格。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，常与动词 do、practice 或 learn 搭配，表示源自日本的徒手武术运动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 karate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 长命, 长寿, 寿命
lemmas.def_en: duration of service

examples.en: A balanced diet and regular exercise are key factors contributing to longevity.
examples.zh: 均衡的饮食和规律的锻炼是促进长寿的关键因素。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数正式用词，常搭配 promote、contribute to，可指人或动植物的长寿，亦可指事物的耐久性。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 longevity 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 布吉伍吉音乐；布吉摇摆舞
lemmas.def_en: an instrumental version of the blues (especially for piano)

examples.en: Everyone hit the dance floor to enjoy a lively boogie before the party ended.
examples.zh: 在派对结束前，大家都走上舞池尽情跳了一段欢快的摇摆舞。

lemmas.phonetic: 布吉伍吉音乐；布吉摇摆舞
lemmas.usage_note: 布吉伍吉音乐；布吉摇摆舞
lemmas.zh: 布吉伍吉音乐；布吉摇摆舞

family_guide.root_logic: 以 boogie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: not genuine or real; being an imitation of the genuine article

examples.en: She chose an elegant coat made of faux fur to support animal welfare.
examples.zh: 为了支持动物保护，她选择了一件人造毛皮制成的高雅大衣。

lemmas.usage_note: 源自法语，通常作前置定语，常与 fur、leather、pearls 连用，多见于时尚和生活语境中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 faux 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the 13th letter of the Greek alphabet

examples.en: The physicist used the symbol nu to denote the frequency of the wave.
examples.zh: 物理学家使用符号nu来表示波的频率。

lemmas.usage_note: 指希腊字母表第十三个字母（Ν/ν），常在物理学、统计学等自然科学文献中用作变量或常数符号。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nu 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a long wandering and eventful journey

examples.en: Her spiritual odyssey led her through various religions before she found inner peace.
examples.zh: 在她找到内心的平静之前，她的精神探索之旅让她接触了多种宗教。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作单数，首字母小写时常比喻漫长曲折的历程或探索，搭配 an odyssey of / embarked on an odyssey。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 odyssey 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: being nine more than ninety

examples.en: The engineer specialized in the design and testing of high-speed IC chips.
examples.zh: 这位工程师专门从事高速集成电路芯片的设计与测试。

lemmas.usage_note: 为 integrated circuit 的首字母缩写定语用法，多作前置定语，用于科技和电子工程语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 无肢[畸形], 缺肢[畸形]
lemmas.def_en: congenital absence of an arm or leg

examples.en: The infant was diagnosed with amelia, a rare congenital disorder characterized by the complete absence of limbs.
examples.zh: 这名婴儿被诊断患有无肢畸形，这是一种以完全缺乏四肢为特征的罕见先天性疾病。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学专业不可数名词，指先天性无肢畸形，多用于儿科、胚胎学或遗传学病理报告中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 amelia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [I] (+ with/for) To compete intensely with others in order to win, gain, or achieve something.

examples.en: Several tech giants are vying with each other for dominance in the artificial intelligence market.
examples.zh: 几家科技巨头正相互竞争，以夺取人工智能市场的主导地位。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，常与 for（争夺目标）或 with（与某人竞争）连用，多见于书面语或新闻报道。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (mathematics) a lack of symmetry

examples.en: The market failure was largely caused by information asymmetry between buyers and sellers.
examples.zh: 市场失灵主要是由买卖双方之间的信息不对称造成的。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指结构、比例或信息上的不对称，常搭配 information asymmetry 或 facial asymmetry。

lemmas.def_en: characterized by asymmetry in the spatial arrangement or placement of parts or components
characterized by asymmetry in the spatial arrangement or placement of parts or components
in an asymmetrical manner

examples.en: they were asymmetrically arranged

family_guide.root_logic: 以 asymmetry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a sensation (as of a cold breeze or bright light) that precedes the onset of certain disorders such as a migraine attack or epileptic seizure

examples.en: The ancient cathedral maintained an aura of quiet dignity despite the surrounding modern bustle.
examples.zh: 尽管周围是现代的喧嚣，这座古老的大教堂依然保持着一种静谧庄严的气氛。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常作单数，常与 an aura of 连用表示环绕某人或某物的独特气质、氛围或神秘光环。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 aura 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a native or resident of Michigan

examples.en: The wolverine is known for its remarkable strength and fierce nature in the Arctic wilderness.
examples.zh: 狼獾以其在北极荒原中惊人的力量和凶猛的天性而闻名。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指北温带凶猛的鼬科动物狼獾，亦可指其皮毛，常用于动物学或自然地理学语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wolverine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 食橱, 碗柜, 餐具柜
lemmas.def_en: a small room (or recess) or cabinet used for storage space

examples.en: She took a clean plate from the cupboard and placed it neatly on the dining table.
examples.zh: 她从碗柜里拿出一个干净的盘子，整齐地摆在餐桌上。

lemmas.usage_note: 日常可数名词，主要指存放碗碟、食物的壁橱或矮柜，习语 a skeleton in the cupboard 意为家丑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cupboard 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] (+ from) To take away a number, amount, or part from a whole.

examples.en: If you subtract the initial costs from the gross revenue, you get the net profit.
examples.zh: 如果从总收入中减去初始成本，就可以得到净利润。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用及物或不及物动词，常用句型为 subtract A from B，表示从整体中扣除某数值或部分。

lemmas.def_en: an arithmetic operation in which the difference between two numbers is calculated

examples.en: the subtraction of three from four leaves one
four minus three equals one

lemmas.def_zh: 减去的, 有负号的, 负的
lemmas.def_en: constituting or involving subtraction

examples.en: a subtractive correction

family_guide.root_logic: 以 subtract 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 交火; 点球大战; 枪战
lemmas.def_en: a fight involving shooting small arms with the intent to kill or frighten

examples.en: The championship match was ultimately decided by a dramatic penalty shootout.
examples.zh: 这场冠军争夺战最终通过一场惊心动魄的点球大战决出了胜负。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，既可指警匪双方密集的武装枪战，也可用于体育赛事中决胜负的“点球大战”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shootout 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: limbless scaly elongate reptile; some are venomous

examples.en: The ancient legend speaks of a sea serpent that guarded the sunken treasures.
examples.zh: 古老的传说中提到了一条守护着沉船宝藏的海中巨蛇。

lemmas.usage_note: 巨蛇；大蛇

family_guide.root_logic: 以 serpent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a small book usually having a paper cover

examples.en: You can pick up a travel brochure at the visitor information center.
examples.zh: 你可以在游客问讯中心领取一份旅游宣传小册子。

lemmas.usage_note: 指用于宣传或介绍的小册子，常与 travel、glossy、promotional 连用，多见于商务与旅游语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 brochure 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: low footwear that can be slipped on and off easily; usually worn indoors

examples.en: He took off his wet boots and slipped into a warm pair of slippers.
examples.zh: 他脱下湿漉漉的靴子，换上了一双暖和的拖鞋。

lemmas.usage_note: 指室内穿的便鞋、拖鞋，常以复数 slippers 形式出现，常与 pair of、put on 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 slipper 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （使）恢复体力，重振旗鼓；给（电池）充电
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To regain physical energy, strength, or enthusiasm by resting. 2. [I, T] To restore electrical energy to a rechargeable battery or device.

examples.en: She spent the weekend in the countryside to relax and recharge her batteries.
examples.zh: 她在乡下度过了一个周末，以放松身心并恢复充沛精力。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指为电池充电，也常引申为通过休整恢复精力；常用搭配 recharge one's batteries。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 recharge 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [T] to spread through and be noticeable in every part of something

examples.en: A deep sense of uncertainty seemed to pervade every corner of the organization.
examples.zh: 一种强烈的不确定感似乎弥漫在该机构的每一个角落。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面及文学用词，指气味、氛围或情绪等弥漫于、充斥于整个空间或群体之中。

lemmas.def_zh: 普遍的, 流行的, 到处蔓延的, 到处渗透的
lemmas.def_en: spreading or spread throughout

examples.en: armed with permeative irony...he punctures affectations
the pervasive odor of garlic

lemmas.def_en: the quality of filling or spreading throughout

examples.en: the pervasiveness of the odor of cabbage in tenement hallways

lemmas.def_zh: 无处不在地, 遍布地
lemmas.def_en: in a pervasive manner

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pervade 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the attribute of being capable of rapid acceleration

examples.en: The robbers used a stolen sports car to make a quick getaway.
examples.zh: 劫匪利用一辆被盗的跑车迅速逃离了现场。

lemmas.usage_note: 多指犯罪后的逃跑（搭配 make a getaway）或短期度假去处（如 weekend getaway）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 getaway 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: hatred of women

examples.en: The campaign aimed to tackle the deeply ingrained culture of online misogyny.
examples.zh: 该活动旨在解决网络上根深蒂固的厌女文化。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式用词，指对女性的厌恶、偏见或仇恨；常与 combat、entrenched、systemic 搭配。

lemmas.def_en: a misanthrope who dislikes women in particular
hating women in particular
hating women in particular

family_guide.root_logic: 以 misogyny 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: deceptive or fraudulent; disposed to cheat or defraud or deceive

examples.en: It is completely dishonest to take credit for work you did not do.
examples.zh: 把别人完成的工作据为己有是极其不诚实的行为。

lemmas.usage_note: 修饰人或行为，表示不诚实、欺诈的；常与 dishonest behavior、dishonest merchant 连用。

lemmas.def_zh: 不诚实地, 不正直地
lemmas.def_en: in a corrupt and deceitful manner

examples.en: he acted dishonestly when he gave the contract to his best friend

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dishonest 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 命令, 禁令, 劝告
lemmas.def_en: a formal command or admonition

examples.en: The court issued a temporary injunction to stop the demolition of the historic building.
examples.zh: 法院发布了一项临时禁令，以阻止拆除这座历史建筑。

lemmas.usage_note: 法律正式用语，指法院发布的强制令或禁令；高频动词搭配有 grant、seek、issue an injunction。

lemmas.def_zh: 吩咐，命令，责成；（法律上）禁止，下禁令
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (+ on/to do) (formal) To instruct or strongly urge someone to do something. 2. [T] (+ from) (law) To issue an official court order preventing or prohibiting someone from doing something.

examples.en: The judge decided to enjoin the company from tearing down the historic building.
examples.zh: 法官决定下令禁止该公司拆除这座历史建筑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 injunction 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an itemized statement of money owed for goods shipped or services rendered

examples.en: Payment must be made within thirty days from the date of the invoice.
examples.zh: 款项必须在发票开具之日起三十天内付清。

lemmas.usage_note: 商业用语，指发票或货款清单；常与 issue、pay、outstanding 连用，多见于商务与财务往来。

lemmas.def_zh: 开具发票（或发货清单）给……；开发票列出（货物或服务）
lemmas.def_en: [T] (+ for) To send an itemized bill to a customer detailing goods or services provided and requesting payment.

examples.en: The consulting firm will invoice us for the travel expenses next week.
examples.zh: 咨询公司下周将就差旅费用向我们开具发票并请款。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指给客户开具发票或记入清单；常用搭配 invoice sb for sth，多用于商务操作。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 invoice 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 小袋, 小包, 眼袋, 邮袋, 育儿袋
lemmas.def_en: a small or medium size container for holding or carrying things

examples.en: He carried a small leather pouch filled with rare coins wherever he went.
examples.zh: 他随身带着一个小皮袋，里面装满了稀有硬币。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指小布袋、皮袋或动物育儿袋，也指眼袋；常见搭配 a tobacco pouch、pouches under the eyes。

lemmas.def_zh: 装入小袋（或囊袋）中；（使）鼓起成袋状
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To put something into a small bag or pouch. 2. [I, T] To bulge outward like a pouch, or cause something to do so.

examples.en: The chipmunk quickly pouched the sunflower seeds in its cheeks before running away.
examples.zh: 花栗鼠迅速把葵花籽塞进腮帮子里，然后跑开了。

lemmas.usage_note: 作及物动词指把物品装入袋中，或使织物等起囊袋状；作不及物动词指鼓起成袋状，多用于文学或专业工艺描述。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pouch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 有益健康的, 合乎卫生的, 健全的, 有益的, 有生气的, 审慎的
lemmas.def_en: conducive to or characteristic of physical or moral well-being

examples.en: The resort offers a variety of wholesome outdoor activities for children and adults alike.
examples.zh: 该度假村为儿童和成人都提供了丰富多样且有益身心的户外活动。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容食物健康有营养，或人品、娱乐活动纯正健康无害；常见搭配 wholesome food、wholesome family entertainment。

lemmas.def_zh: 不卫生的, 不适合健康的, 有害身体的, 腐败的
lemmas.def_en: detrimental to physical or moral well-being

examples.en: unwholesome food
unwholesome habits like smoking

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being beneficial and generally good for you

lemmas.def_zh: 卫生地, 有益健康地
lemmas.def_en: in a wholesome manner

examples.en: the papers we found shed some valuable light on this question, wholesomely contradicting all lies

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wholesome 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 一群；步兵大队；支持者；共同特点的一群人
lemmas.def_en: a company of companions or supporters

examples.en: The epidemiological study followed a cohort of five thousand patients over a ten-year period.
examples.zh: 这项流行病学研究对一组包含五千名患者的人群进行了为期十年的跟踪。

lemmas.usage_note: 学术与统计中指具有相同统计特征的受试群体；日常或政治语境常指同伴、支持者，常带轻微贬义。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cohort 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 栗子, 栗树, 栗色
lemmas.def_en: wood of any of various chestnut trees of the genus Castanea

examples.en: The vendor was selling hot roasted chestnuts on the corner of the snowy street.
examples.zh: 小贩在积雪的街角售卖热腾腾的炒栗子。

lemmas.usage_note: 指栗子、栗树或红棕色；口语中也可引申为‘老掉牙的笑话或老套话题’，如 roast chestnuts、an old chestnut。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chestnut 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the descendants of one individual

examples.en: She was able to trace her noble lineage directly back to the fourteenth century.
examples.zh: 她能够将自己的贵族血统直接追溯到十四世纪。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式用语，指家族血统、宗族世系或物种的演化谱系；常见搭配 trace one's lineage、ancient lineage。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lineage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a rod used by a magician or water diviner

examples.en: The magician waved his wand, and the white dove vanished instantly into thin air.
examples.zh: 魔术师挥动魔杖，白鸽瞬间消失得无影无踪。

lemmas.usage_note: 指魔杖、指挥棒或便携式手持扫描棒、化妆刷棒；常见搭配 magic wand、mascara wand、metal detector wand。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wand 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a mixture of sulfides that forms when sulfide metal ores are smelted

examples.en: The visual effects team created a digital matte to blend the actors seamlessly into the alien landscape.
examples.zh: 视觉特效团队制作了数字遮罩，将演员天衣无缝地融入外星景观中。

lemmas.usage_note: 指摄影与影视制作中的遮罩底片，或冶金学中的冰铜；属于专业技术领域的专有名词。

lemmas.def_zh: （在影视或摄影中）用遮罩遮蔽（或合成）；使表面无光泽
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (film / photography) To mask out or combine areas of an image or film shot using a matte. 2. [T] To make a surface dull or matte.

examples.en: The technicians matted out the green screen background to insert the CGI explosion.
examples.zh: 技术人员对绿幕背景进行了遮罩抠像处理，以置入电脑合成的爆炸效果。

lemmas.usage_note: 影视特效中指使用遮罩抠像合成画面，工业中指使表面无光泽化；多用于专业技术语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 matte 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不断提供，连续供给（食物、酒等）；不断向……发问；从事（行业）；定期往返于
lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. (+ with) To keep offering or supplying someone with large amounts of food, drink, or questions. 2. To work steadily at a trade or profession. 3. [I, T] To travel regularly along a route.

examples.en: Local ferries ply between the harbor and the outer islands several times a day.
examples.zh: 当地渡轮每天在港口和外岛之间定期往返数次。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物指不断向某人提供（ply sb with sth）或操持工具、经营行业（ply a trade）；不及物指船只定期航行（ply between）。

lemmas.def_zh: 钳子(如老虎钳,手钳,扁嘴钳等),镊子
lemmas.def_en: someone who plies a trade
someone who plies a trade

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ply 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 要塞, 堡垒, 大本营
lemmas.def_en: a strongly fortified defensive structure

examples.en: The remote mountain valley has long been a political stronghold for the conservative party.
examples.zh: 这座偏远的山谷长期以来一直是保守党的政治大本营。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指坚固的军事堡垒、要塞，也常比喻某种思想、政治派系或濒危动物的大本营或根据地。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stronghold 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: bedding made of two layers of cloth filled with stuffing and stitched together

examples.en: My grandmother made a beautiful patchwork quilt out of old fabric scraps.
examples.zh: 我祖母用旧碎布缝制了一床美丽的拼接被。

lemmas.usage_note: 指绗缝被、拼接棉被；常用于日常生活，搭配如 patchwork quilt、down quilt。

lemmas.def_zh: 缝制（被褥或棉衣），做绗缝；绗缝
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To make a quilt, or to stitch layers of fabric together with soft padding in between.

examples.en: She quilted the three layers together with precise, even stitches.
examples.zh: 她用细密均匀的针脚将这三层材料绗缝在了一起。

lemmas.usage_note: 指通过缝线将夹层絮料固定（绗缝），或引申为东拼西凑地拼接；常见过去分词作定语 quilted jacket。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 quilt 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 洗手间；休息室；更衣室；厕所
lemmas.def_en: a toilet that is available to the public

examples.en: Excuse me, could you please tell me where the nearest restroom is?
examples.zh: 打扰一下，请问最近的洗手间在哪里？

lemmas.usage_note: 美式英语中公共厕所的委婉礼貌说法，常搭配 public restroom 或 use the restroom。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 restroom 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a low dam built across a stream to raise its level or divert its flow

examples.en: The local council built a stone weir across the river to control the flow of water.
examples.zh: 当地委员会在河上修建了一道石堰以调节水流。

lemmas.usage_note: 水利与地理专业名词，指横跨河流用于调控水位的水堰，常与 river, canal 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 weir 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （使）瓦解，（使）崩溃；（使）碎裂，（使）分解
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. To break up into small pieces or fragments. 2. To become much weaker or collapse completely.

examples.en: The ancient spacecraft began to disintegrate as soon as it entered the Earth's atmosphere.
examples.zh: 那艘古老的航天器一进入地球大气层就碎裂解体了。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可作及物也可作不及物动词，指物理碎裂或组织、系统瓦解，常与 into fragments 搭配。

lemmas.def_en: in a decomposed state

lemmas.def_zh: 使分裂的, 使崩溃的
lemmas.def_en: tending to cause breakup into constituent elements or parts

family_guide.root_logic: 以 disintegrate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 宣传，大肆宣扬；公布，向公众宣传
lemmas.def_en: [T] To make information about something widely known to the public through the media; to advertise.

examples.en: The studio launched an aggressive campaign to publicize the upcoming sci-fi movie.
examples.zh: 制片厂发起了一场声势浩大的活动来宣传这部即将上映的科幻电影。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指通过媒体或广告向公众广泛宣传推广，常与 heavily, widely 搭配。

lemmas.def_zh: 国际法学家, 政治评论家, 政治作家, 广告员
lemmas.def_en: someone who publicizes

examples.en: The actor refused to answer any personal questions without consulting his publicist first.
examples.zh: 在未事先咨询其公关顾问的情况下，该演员拒绝回答任何个人问题。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指负责公关、宣传的名人或机构公关人员，常搭配 personal publicist。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 publicize 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 含糊不清地发音，含糊地念；诋毁，诽谤
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To pronounce words unclearly or indistinctly so that the sounds run together. 2. [T] To make an insulting remark that damages someone's reputation.

examples.en: Exhausted from the long shift, the doctor began to slur his words noticeably.
examples.zh: 长时间轮班带来的极度疲惫，让医生的发音明显变得含糊不清。

lemmas.usage_note: 动词，多指因醉酒或疲劳而吐字不清，常用搭配 slur one's words 或 slur speech。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 slur 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (of a plant) To dry up, shrink, and die, or cause to do so. 2. [I] To gradually become weaker, fade away, or disappear.

examples.en: Without sufficient funding and public interest, the ambitious project gradually withered away.
examples.zh: 由于缺乏充足的资金和公众关注，这项雄心勃勃的项目逐渐走向消亡。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可指植物枯萎，也常比喻希望、感情或支持衰退消亡，常与 wither away 连用。

lemmas.def_zh: 使人不自在地；令人难堪地（withering的副词形式）
lemmas.def_en: in a withering manner

examples.en: guns fired witheringly at the railroad cars

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 毁灭性的；使人难堪的；枯萎的
lemmas.def_en: intended to make someone feel humiliated or foolish; devastating
lemmas.usage_note: 最常用来修饰目光、评论或言辞，如 a withering look/remark，意指令人无地自容的。

examples.en: He shot her a withering look that silenced her instantly.
examples.zh: 他朝她投去严厉而轻蔑的一瞥，让她立刻闭了嘴。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wither 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a piece of soft material that covers and protects an injured part of the body

examples.en: The paramedic tightly wrapped a sterile bandage around the runner's sprained ankle.
examples.zh: 急救人员用无菌绷带紧紧包扎了那名跑步者扭伤的脚踝。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指医用包扎伤口的绷带，常见搭配 apply a bandage 或 wrap with a bandage。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (+ up) To wrap an injured body part with a strip of cloth to protect it.

examples.en: The nurse gently cleaned the cut on his arm before bandaging it up securely.
examples.zh: 护士在把他的手臂伤口牢牢包扎好之前，先进行了温和的清洁。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指用绷带包扎身体部位或伤口，常与介词 up 连用构成 bandage up。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 缠着绷带的；包扎过的
lemmas.def_en: covered, wrapped, or supported with a bandage
lemmas.usage_note: 常直接作前置定语修饰身体部位，如 bandaged arm / leg / head。

examples.en: He raised his heavily bandaged hand to wave hello.
examples.zh: 他举起包扎得严严实实的手招手致意。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bandage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a percussion instrument consisting of a set of tuned bells that are struck with a hammer; used as an orchestral instrument

examples.en: The soothing chime of the grandfather clock filled the quiet living room every hour.
examples.zh: 每隔一小时，落地钟舒缓的钟声就会回荡在安静的客厅里。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指成套风铃或钟声鸣响发出的清脆乐音，常搭配 the chime of bells 或 wind chimes。

lemmas.def_zh: （钟等）鸣响，敲出和谐的乐声；（钟表）打钟报时；插话，附和 (chime in)
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] When bells or a clock chime, they make a clear, musical ringing sound. 2. [T] (of a clock) To indicate the hour by ringing musical strokes.

examples.en: The cathedral bells chimed midnight, echoing across the silent, snow-covered square.
examples.zh: 大教堂的钟声敲响了午夜，回荡在寂静且白雪皑皑的广场上。

lemmas.usage_note: 动词，指钟表敲击报时，比喻用法 chime in 表示插话，常搭配 chime the hour。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chime 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (law) To officially order someone to appear in court or produce evidence using a subpoena.

examples.en: The grand jury decided to subpoena the key witness to testify regarding the corporate fraud.
examples.zh: 大陪审团决定传唤该关键证人出庭就企业欺诈案作证。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式法律用语，及物动词，指法院传讯某人出庭作证，常接宾语 sb. to testify。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 subpoena 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the fur of an otter

examples.en: A playful sea otter was floating on its back, cracking a clam open with a stone.
examples.zh: 一只顽皮的海獭仰面漂浮在水面上，正用石头砸开一个蛤蜊。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指半水栖食肉动物水獭，常见组合有 sea otter（海獭）或 river otter。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 otter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: entering a building unlawfully with intent to commit a felony or to steal valuable property

examples.en: Police are investigating a string of burglaries that took place in the neighborhood last week.
examples.zh: 警方正在调查上周该街区发生的一连串入室盗窃案。

lemmas.usage_note: 入室盗窃（罪）

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (chiefly British) To enter a building illegally in order to steal property from it.

examples.en: Thieves managed to burgle the downtown jewelry shop during the blackout last night.
examples.zh: 窃贼昨晚趁停电时破门潜入了市中心的那家珠宝店行窃。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (chiefly North American) To enter a building illegally in order to steal property from it.

family_guide.root_logic: 以 burglary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 脊椎, 志气, 骨干, 支柱
lemmas.def_en: a central cohesive source of support and stability

examples.en: Small and medium-sized enterprises form the backbone of the national economy.
examples.zh: 中小型企业构成了国民经济的支柱。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指解剖学脊椎，更常比喻支柱或毅力；常搭配form the backbone of或have no backbone。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 backbone 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 渴望的, 急切的, 劲头十足的
lemmas.def_en: (often followed by `for') ardently or excessively desirous

examples.en: An avid collector of vintage vinyl, she spends her weekends scouring flea markets.
examples.zh: 作为一名狂热的黑胶唱片收藏者，她周末总在跳蚤市场淘货。

lemmas.usage_note: 多作前置定语修饰爱好者，如avid reader/fan；表极度热衷，情感色彩积极。

lemmas.def_en: in an avid manner

examples.en: whatever the flavor or color of your local paper, do remember that these are read avidly for local information

lemmas.def_zh: 热望, 急切, 利欲心
lemmas.def_en: a positive feeling of wanting to push ahead with something

family_guide.root_logic: 以 avid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不符合, 差异, 不相符之处
lemmas.def_en: a difference between conflicting facts or claims or opinions

examples.en: The internal audit revealed a major discrepancy between the actual cash reserves and the ledger.
examples.zh: 内部审计揭示了实际现金储备与账面记录之间的重大出入。

lemmas.usage_note: 指两组数据或陈述之间的不符与出入，常接between...and...，常见于财务与审计语境。

lemmas.def_zh: 不符合的, 有差异的, 矛盾的
lemmas.def_en: not compatible with other facts

examples.en: The auditor discovered discrepant figures between the internal inventory logs and the tax forms.
examples.zh: 审计员发现内部库存记录与报税单据之间的数据存在矛盾。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 discrepancy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 完整的事物, 整体, 整数
lemmas.def_en: any of the natural numbers (positive or negative) or zero

examples.en: The function expects an integer as its primary input argument.
examples.zh: 该函数需要一个整数作为其主要输入参数。

lemmas.usage_note: 数学与计算机科学专业词汇，指正负整数或零，常与positive/negative搭配使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 integer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a district of a city marked by poverty and inferior living conditions

examples.en: Many rural migrants ended up living in overcrowded slums on the outskirts of the metropolis.
examples.zh: 许多农村移民最终居住在大都市郊区拥挤的贫民窟里。

lemmas.usage_note: 指城市贫民窟，多用复数slums；高频搭配urban slums、clear/demolish slums。

lemmas.def_zh: （slum it）在简陋条件下度日；逛贫民窟，体验下层生活
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] ('slum it') (informal) To live or spend time in conditions much poorer or less comfortable than you are used to. 2. [I] To visit poor or disreputable areas out of curiosity.

examples.en: Wealthy tourists often slum it by staying in low-budget hostels just for the novelty.
examples.zh: 富有的游客往往屈就住在廉价青年旅舍，只为图个新鲜。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，常与it连用构成slum it，口语中指“屈就体验艰苦简陋的生活”。

lemmas.def_en: (of housing or residential areas) indicative of poverty

examples.en: a slummy part of town
slum conditions

family_guide.root_logic: 以 slum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 雪崩, 山崩, 大量
lemmas.def_en: a slide of large masses of snow and ice and mud down a mountain

examples.en: The company was overwhelmed by an avalanche of customer complaints after the update failed.
examples.zh: 更新失败后，该公司被雪崩般涌来的客户投诉所淹没。

lemmas.usage_note: 指雪崩，亦常引申为如雪崩般涌来的事物；常见短语an avalanche of letters/calls。

lemmas.def_zh: 崩塌，雪崩般坍落；大量涌至
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (of snow, rock, or earth) To slide down a mountainside in a sudden mass. 2. [I] To arrive or occur suddenly in overwhelming numbers.

examples.en: Loose rocks avalanched down the steep slope, narrowly missing the hikers below.
examples.zh: 松散的岩石从陡坡上轰然崩落，险些砸中下方的登山者。

lemmas.usage_note: 动词表示雪崩或大量涌下/席卷而至，多作不及物动词，描绘不可阻挡的倾泻之势。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 avalanche 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 爆发, 越狱, 突围
lemmas.def_en: an escape from jail

examples.en: The guards managed to thwart a daring breakout attempt by three inmates.
examples.zh: 警卫设法挫败了三名囚犯一次大胆的越狱企图。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指越狱、冲突突然爆发或商业突围；复合名词，常见搭配prison breakout。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 breakout 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: very high frequency sound; used in ultrasonography

examples.en: The routine ultrasound scan confirmed that the twin fetuses were developing normally.
examples.zh: 常规超声波检查确认双胞胎胎儿发育正常。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指超声波物理现象，也指超声波医学检查；常与have/undergo an ultrasound搭配。

lemmas.def_en: having frequencies above those of audible sound

examples.en: Engineers used ultrasonic sensors to detect micro-cracks inside the aircraft fuselage.
examples.zh: 工程师使用超声波传感器检测飞机机身内部的微小裂缝。

lemmas.usage_note: 定语形容词，指超声波的或利用超声工作的，常见搭配ultrasonic waves/testing。

lemmas.def_en: by ultrasonic means

examples.en: the kidney stones were removed ultrasonically

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ultrasound 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or near the head end or toward the front plane of a body

examples.en: The surgeon carefully repaired the patient's anterior cruciate ligament to restore knee stability.
examples.zh: 外科医生仔细修复了患者的前交叉韧带，以恢复膝关节的稳定性。

lemmas.usage_note: 解剖学中指身体“前面的”；正式语体中表时间“在先的”，可接介词to。

lemmas.def_zh: 先前地；居先地；在前面, 在以前
lemmas.def_en: in an anterior direction

family_guide.root_logic: 以 anterior 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 径流(量), 决赛, 决定性竞选
lemmas.def_en: the occurrence of surplus liquid (as water) exceeding the limit or capacity

examples.en: Toxic agricultural runoff has severely contaminated the local river system.
examples.zh: 含有毒农药的农业径流严重污染了当地的河流系统。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指地表径流或选举决选；常与 agricultural、surface 或 election 搭配，多用于环境科学与政治语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 runoff 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 明显的, 公然的, 蓄意的
lemmas.def_en: open and observable; not secret or hidden

examples.en: Despite their political differences, neither country engaged in overt military aggression.
examples.zh: 尽管存在政治分歧，两国均未采取公开的军事侵略行动。

lemmas.usage_note: 修饰公然、不加掩饰的行为或敌意；常搭配 overt hostility、overt act，反义词为 covert，多用于正式文本。

lemmas.def_zh: 明显地；公开地, 公然地
lemmas.def_en: in an overt manner

examples.en: he did it overtly

family_guide.root_logic: 以 overt 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 犯人, 罪犯, 刑事被告
lemmas.def_en: someone who perpetrates wrongdoing

examples.en: High sugar consumption is often identified as the main culprit behind tooth decay.
examples.zh: 高糖摄入常被认为是导致蛀牙的罪魁祸首。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可指犯罪嫌疑人，也广泛用于指导致负面结果的罪魁祸首；常与 identify、main 搭配，应用广泛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 culprit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a tool for tamping (e.g., for tamping tobacco into a pipe bowl or a charge into a drill hole etc.)

examples.en: The gardener used a heavy iron tamp to level the soil before laying down the paving stones.
examples.zh: 园丁在铺设铺路石前，用一把沉重的铁夯将土壤压实平整。

lemmas.usage_note: 指用于夯实泥土、碎石或压平烟丝的工具；多用于工程施工或特定手工工具语境，常作可数名词。

lemmas.def_zh: 捣棒, 打夯机, 填塞者
lemmas.def_en: a tool for tamping (e.g., for tamping tobacco into a pipe bowl or a charge into a drill hole etc.)
[T] (+ down) To ram or press something down firmly by repeated light blows.

examples.en: He tamped down the fresh earth around the sapling to ensure it stood firmly.
examples.zh: 他把幼苗周围的新土夯实，以确保它能稳固直立。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示用力压实或夯平，常与 down 连用构成 tamp down；引申可表示压制、抑制情绪或通胀等抽象事物。

lemmas.def_zh: 暗中乱动，胡乱摆弄；篡改
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] ('tamper with') To touch, alter, or interfere with something secretly and without permission, often causing damage.

examples.en: Someone tampered with the documents on my desk
The reporter fiddle with the facts

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tamp 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To make a problem, bad situation, or negative feeling worse or more severe.

examples.en: The ongoing drought will only exacerbate the severe food shortages in the region.
examples.zh: 持续的干旱只会加剧该地区严重的粮食短缺。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面语动词，意为使病情、问题或危机恶化；常搭配 the situation、tension、problem。

lemmas.def_zh: 恶化, 增剧, 激怒
lemmas.def_en: action that makes a problem or a disease (or its symptoms) worse

examples.en: the aggravation of her condition resulted from lack of care

family_guide.root_logic: 以 exacerbate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 变出，神奇般地创造出（常后接 up）；用魔法变出；令人联想起
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (often + up) To make something appear or create something as if by magic. 2. [T] To evoke or bring an image or feeling to mind. 3. [I, T] To perform magic tricks.

examples.en: The smell of pine needles conjured up fond childhood memories of winter holidays.
examples.zh: 松针的气味勾起了关于童年冬日假期的美好回忆。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与 up 搭配构成 conjure up，表示使浮现在脑海或变戏法变出；也可指念咒召唤神怪，文风生动具象。

lemmas.def_zh: 恳求者, 施魔术者, 变戏法的人, 魔术师, 念咒的人, 非常聪明的人
lemmas.def_en: someone who performs magic tricks to amuse an audience

lemmas.def_zh: 祈祷, 祈求, 戏法, 咒文, 魔术, 妖术
lemmas.def_en: a ritual recitation of words or sounds believed to have a magical effect

lemmas.def_zh: 恳求者, 施魔术者, 变戏法的人, 魔术师, 念咒的人, 非常聪明的人
lemmas.def_en: someone who performs magic tricks to amuse an audience

family_guide.root_logic: 以 conjure 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 仔细剖析，深入分析；解剖（动植物尸体）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To examine or analyze an argument, text, or failure in minute detail. 2. [T] To cut open a dead body or plant to study its internal structure.

examples.en: In the seminar, the professor thoroughly dissected the flaws in the economic model.
examples.zh: 在研讨会上，教授彻底剖析了该经济模型中的缺陷。

lemmas.usage_note: 指生物学上的解剖动物/植物，或引申为严密、透彻地剖析理论与论点；常用于学术与批评语境。

lemmas.def_en: cutting so as to separate into pieces

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dissect 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a clergyman ministering to some institution

examples.en: The military chaplain offered comfort and spiritual guidance to the wounded soldiers.
examples.zh: 随军牧师向受伤的士兵提供安慰与精神引导。

lemmas.usage_note: 指军队、医院、学校或监狱等非教会机构中的专职神职人员；常与 prison、hospital、military 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chaplain 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To push something sharp or pointed into or towards someone or something with a quick, hard movement. 2. [I, T] (boxing) To hit someone with a short, quick punch.

examples.en: She impatiently jabbed at the elevator button several times with her finger.
examples.zh: 她不耐烦地用手指连戳了好几下电梯按钮。

lemmas.usage_note: 强调快速、突兀地戳、刺或击打；常接 at 或 with 介词短语，动作短促而有力，多用于口语及叙事文本。

lemmas.def_zh: n. （拳击中的）刺拳；戳，刺；（口语）预防针，注射
lemmas.def_en: a quick, sharp blow, especially with the fist; a sudden thrust; (informal) a hypodermic injection
lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，在英式英语及口语中常指疫苗接种（如 flu jab）。

examples.en: He caught his opponent with a quick left jab.
examples.zh: 他用快速的左刺拳击中了对手。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jab 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 公平的, 不偏不倚的
lemmas.def_en: showing lack of favoritism

examples.en: A judge must remain entirely impartial throughout the trial, regardless of personal feelings.
examples.zh: 不论个人感情如何，法官在整个审判过程中必须保持完全客观公正。

lemmas.usage_note: 修饰客观、无偏见的态度、裁判或观察员；常搭配 impartial advice、impartial observer，多见于法律与正式语境。

lemmas.def_zh: 公平, 无私, 不偏
lemmas.def_en: an inclination to weigh both views or opinions equally

lemmas.def_zh: 公平地, 无私地; 秉公
lemmas.def_en: in an impartial manner

examples.en: he smiled at them both impartially

family_guide.root_logic: 以 impartial 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] to form soft, solid lumps from a liquid, or cause blood, cream, etc. to thicken into lumps

examples.en: Certain medications are prescribed to prevent blood from clotting too quickly inside the veins.
examples.zh: 医生开具了某些药物，以防止静脉内的血液过快凝结。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作不及物动词，指血液或液体凝结成块，常与together连用；医学语境高频使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 clot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the way two individuals relate to each other

examples.en: Through some creative alchemy, the director turned a low-budget script into a cinematic masterpiece.
examples.zh: 凭借某种创造性的魔力，这位导演将一份低成本剧本变成了电影杰作。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，原指中世纪炼金术，现多比喻化腐朽为神奇的魔力或奇妙的转变过程。

lemmas.def_en: one who was versed in the practice of alchemy and who sought an elixir of life and a panacea and an alkahest and the philosopher's stone
related to or concerned with alchemy
related to or concerned with alchemy

family_guide.root_logic: 以 alchemy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the soccer or hockey player assigned to protect the goal

examples.en: The hockey goalie made an incredible diving save in the final seconds of the game.
examples.zh: 那位冰球守门员在比赛最后几秒做出了不可思议的飞身扑救。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，是goalkeeper的非正式口语表达，常见于足球、冰球等体育解说与日常交际中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 goalie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: using or knowing two languages

examples.en: Growing up in Montreal, she enjoyed the advantages of a bilingual education in English and French.
examples.zh: 在蒙特利尔长大的她，享受了英法双语教育的优势。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，常修饰education、community或individual，指能熟练使用两种语言的或双语的。

lemmas.def_en: a person who speaks two languages fluently

examples.en: Simultaneous interpreters are almost always fluent bilinguals with sharp cognitive reflexes.
examples.zh: 同声传译员几乎都是具备敏锐认知反应的双语者。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指能够流利使用两种语言的人，在语言学、认知科学和人才招聘场景中常见。

lemmas.def_en: in a bilingual manner

examples.en: she grew up bilingually

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bilingual 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: pigment mixed with water-soluble glutinous materials such as size and egg yolk

examples.en: The Italian Renaissance artist preferred egg tempera for its fast-drying properties and luminous finish.
examples.zh: 这位意大利文艺复兴时期的艺术家偏爱蛋彩画法，因为其干燥迅速且光泽明亮。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，专用于艺术领域，常搭配paint、technique或panel，指蛋彩画颜料或画法。

lemmas.def_zh: 气质, 性格, 性情
lemmas.def_en: your usual mood

examples.en: he has a happy disposition

lemmas.def_zh: 气质的, 性格的, 易兴奋的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or caused by temperament

examples.en: temperamental indifference to neatness
temperamental peculiarities

lemmas.def_zh: 在气质上; 易兴奋地, 神经质地
lemmas.def_en: by temperament

examples.en: temperamentally suited to each other

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tempera 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 峡谷, 凹槽, 塞饱, 咽喉
lemmas.def_en: a deep ravine (usually with a river running through it)

examples.en: A suspension bridge spans the deep river gorge, offering stunning views of the valley below.
examples.zh: 一座吊桥横跨深邃的河流峡谷，俯瞰山谷的景致令人惊叹。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指两壁陡峭的狭长峡谷；也见于成语one's gorge rises（令人作呕）。

lemmas.def_zh: 狼吞虎咽，大吃大嚼；塞饱
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To eat a large amount of food greedily and until completely full.

examples.en: The children gorged themselves on leftover chocolate and sweets until they felt sick.
examples.zh: 孩子们大口狂吃剩下的巧克力和糖果，直到吃得恶心为止。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于反身结构gorge oneself on sth，表示放纵地大吃大嚼、狼吞虎咽以至撑饱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gorge 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 呻吟，叹息；呻吟着抱怨；发出吱吱嘎嘎声（如重压之下）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (+ with/at) To make a long, deep sound of physical pain, grief, or disapproval, or say something while groaning. 2. [I] (+ under) To make a strained creaking sound under heavy pressure.

examples.en: The old wooden floorboards groaned beneath his cautious footsteps in the dark.
examples.zh: 在黑暗中，老旧的木质地板在他谨慎的脚步声下发出吱嘎呻吟。

lemmas.usage_note: 可表人因痛苦、无奈而呻吟（groan with pain），或物在重压下吱嘎作响（groan under）。

lemmas.def_en: an utterance expressing pain or disapproval

examples.en: A collective groan went up from the crowd as the striker missed the decisive penalty.
examples.zh: 当前锋罚丢决定胜负的点球时，人群中爆发出一片齐声叹息。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指痛苦、绝望或不满时发出的叹息声、呻吟声，常与heave、utter搭配。

lemmas.def_en: a person who groans

family_guide.root_logic: 以 groan 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: tall palm tree bearing coconuts as fruits; widely planted throughout the tropics

examples.en: Tall coco palms swayed gently in the tropical breeze along the white sandy shoreline.
examples.zh: 高大的椰子树在热带微风中沿着白色沙滩海岸轻轻摇曳。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指椰子树或椰子，植物学中常作coco palm使用，注意与可可（cocoa）区分。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 coco 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 分类帐, 分户总帐, 盖墓石板, 横木
lemmas.def_en: a record in which commercial accounts are recorded

examples.en: The accountant meticulously recorded every daily transaction into the company's general ledger.
examples.zh: 会计细致地将每日的每笔交易记录在公司的总分类账中。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，会计与金融核心词，指总账、分类账簿，常与keep、enter in搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ledger 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: alternative names for the body of a human being

examples.en: The sports car features an ultra-lightweight aluminum chassis designed to improve handling at high speeds.
examples.zh: 这款跑车采用了超轻质铝合金底盘，旨在提升高速行驶时的操控性。

lemmas.usage_note: 单复数同形名词（复数读音末尾发/z/），指车辆底盘、车架或电子设备机箱承载骨架。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chassis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 自动的；机器人的, 像机器人的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to mechanical robots

examples.en: The surgeon used a robotic arm to perform the minimally invasive operation with extreme precision.
examples.zh: 外科医生使用机械臂极其精准地完成了这台微创手术。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰 arm、system 等表示机械自动化，亦可比喻人的动作或声音机械呆板、缺乏感情。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 robotic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: subject to or caused by an earthquake or earth vibration

examples.en: The sudden collapse of the bank caused a seismic shift in the nation's financial landscape.
examples.zh: 该银行的骤然倒闭在该国金融格局中引起了剧烈动荡。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指地质学上的地震活动，也常在政经语境中引申为“重大而具破坏性的、剧烈的”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 seismic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 美味的, 可口的, 赏心悦目的, 愉快的
lemmas.def_en: extremely pleasing to the sense of taste

examples.en: Mom baked some yummy chocolate chip cookies for our afternoon snack.
examples.zh: 妈妈烤了一些美味的巧克力曲奇作为我们的下午点心。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式口语词，多用于儿童语境或日常赞美食物美味，口吻轻松活泼，也可口语形容人有吸引力。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 yummy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: with one side forward or to the front

examples.en: He glanced sideways at his colleague to see if she had noticed the mistake.
examples.zh: 他斜眼瞥了一下同事，看她是否注意到了那个错误。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示向侧面移动或斜视，常与 look、glance、move 等动词连用；亦可比喻计划或事情出差错走偏。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sideways 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the general location where something is

examples.en: The police are appealing to the public for any information regarding the suspect's whereabouts.
examples.zh: 警方正呼吁公众提供有关该嫌疑人下落的任何线索。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常作复数或不可数名词，谓语动词单复数皆可，常与 of 搭配，指某人或某物的行踪、下落。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 whereabouts 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a domesticated gallinaceous bird thought to be descended from the red jungle fowl

examples.en: The local farm specializes in raising organic poultry without the use of routine antibiotics.
examples.zh: 这家当地农场专门饲养不常规使用抗生素的有机家禽。

lemmas.usage_note: 集体名词，指鸡鸭鹅等家禽或禽肉；指活家禽时通常接复数动词，指禽肉时多用作不可数名词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 poultry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a colorless odorless gas used as a fuel

examples.en: Reducing methane emissions from agriculture is vital for combating global warming.
examples.zh: 减少农业甲烷排放对于应对全球变暖至关重要。

lemmas.usage_note: 科技与环保类不可数名词，指无色无味的天然气主要成分，常与 emissions、gas 等词搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 methane 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 以免, 唯恐, 免得
lemmas.def_en: being ten more than forty

examples.en: She whispered her secrets softly lest she be overheard by anyone in the hallway.
examples.zh: 她轻声细语地说着秘密，唯恐被走廊里的任何人偷听到。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面庄重连接词，意为“唯恐/以免”，从句谓语常使用虚拟语气（should + 动词原形或直接用动词原形）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lest 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无价的, 价值无法衡量的
lemmas.def_en: having incalculable monetary, intellectual, or spiritual worth

examples.en: Her extensive experience in crisis management proved invaluable to the startup during the audit.
examples.zh: 事实证明，她在危机管理方面的丰富经验在审计期间对这家初创公司起到了极为宝贵的作用。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示价值极高而无法衡量（切勿误解为无价值），常修饰 experience、advice、support 等抽象名词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 invaluable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an Australian boomerang; one side flat and the other convex

examples.en: The museum display included a traditional wooden kylie used by Indigenous hunters for bringing down birds.
examples.zh: 博物馆的展品中包括一把土著猎人用来击落鸟类的传统木质回飞棒。

lemmas.usage_note: 澳大利亚英语专有词汇，指澳洲原住民用于狩猎且通常不返回的特定类型回飞棒，多作可数名词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kylie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 鉴别力, 才能, 天资, 资质, 眼光
lemmas.def_en: a natural talent

examples.en: She has a natural flair for interior design and can transform any dull room.
examples.zh: 她对室内设计有着天生的敏锐眼光，能让任何沉闷的房间焕然一新。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作单数，表示天赋或敏锐眼光，极常与介词 for 搭配（a flair for sth）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 flair 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a fibrous amphibole; used for making fireproof articles; inhaling fibers can cause asbestosis or lung cancer

examples.en: Workers were exposed to hazardous asbestos fibers during the demolition of the old factory.
examples.zh: 工人们在拆除旧厂房的过程中暴露在危险的石棉纤维中。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，专指石棉材料，常见于建筑、消防及职业病防护等正式语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 asbestos 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: primitive chlorophyll-containing mainly aquatic eukaryotic organisms lacking true stems and roots and leaves

examples.en: Excessive fertilizer runoff caused toxic algae to spread rapidly across the lake.
examples.zh: 过量的化肥径流导致有毒藻类在湖面上迅速蔓延。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，alga 的复数形式（常用复数），动词谓语常接复数，指水生藻类植物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 algae 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 榛子, 榛树, 淡褐色
lemmas.def_en: Australian tree grown especially for ornament and its fine-grained wood and bearing edible nuts

examples.en: The squirrel hid beneath the dense branches of a wild hazel.
examples.zh: 松鼠藏在了一棵野生榛树茂密的枝叶下。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数指榛树，不可数指浅褐色；日常生活中极常用于修饰眼球颜色或指代植物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hazel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 归国, 省亲回家, 同学会
lemmas.def_en: an annual school or university reunion for graduates

examples.en: The soldiers received an emotional homecoming from their families at the airport.
examples.zh: 士兵们在机场受到了家人们满怀深情的归国欢迎。

lemmas.usage_note: 可作指回家、重返故土的经历，在北美校园语境中专指秋季举行的“校友返校周”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 homecoming 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an open jar of glass or porcelain used as an ornament or to hold flowers

examples.en: He placed a delicate porcelain vase on the dining table as a centerpiece.
examples.zh: 他在餐桌中央摆放了一个精致的瓷花瓶作为装饰。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指插花或装饰用的花瓶，常与 a vase of flowers 或 antique vase 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vase 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: being the one previously mentioned or spoken of

examples.en: The aforementioned criteria must be strictly followed throughout the entire experiment.
examples.zh: 在整个实验过程中，必须严格遵守前述标准。

lemmas.usage_note: 仅作前置定语，常与定冠词 the 连用，多见于法律文书、合同或学术等严谨书面语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 aforementioned 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: as acknowledged

examples.en: Admittedly, the project involves high risks, but the potential rewards are immense.
examples.zh: 诚然，该项目风险极高，但潜在的回报却十分丰厚。

lemmas.usage_note: 评注性副词，常置于句首或插入句中，引出让步事实，相当于“诚然/不可否认的是”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 admittedly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 手电筒, 闪光信号灯
lemmas.def_en: a small portable battery-powered electric lamp

examples.en: She switched on her flashlight to illuminate the dark attic path.
examples.zh: 她打开手电筒，照亮了阁楼里黑暗的通道。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，美式英语中专指手电筒（英式多用 torch），常与动词 turn on/shine 搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 flashlight 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 成为（雄性亲本）繁育出；作为……的雄性父本
lemmas.def_en: [T] (especially of a male domestic animal, such as a stallion) To be the father of offspring.

examples.en: The champion stallion has sired several race-winning horses over the past decade.
examples.zh: 这匹冠军种马在过去的十年里繁育出了数匹屡夺赛事头筹的赛马。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，严格用于生物学或畜牧业中指“（雄性动物）繁衍、成为……的父本”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sire 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [I] (+ with/about/over) To have an angry argument or serious disagreement with someone.

examples.en: They used to quarrel constantly over the most trivial household chores.
examples.zh: 他们过去常常为了最琐碎的家务事争吵不休。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与 with sb. 或 about/over sth. 搭配，表示因琐事发生口角或争吵，口语与书面语皆常用。

lemmas.def_zh: 吵架, 反目, 怨言, 方头凿
lemmas.def_en: an angry dispute

examples.en: A bitter quarrel between the two business partners led to the company's collapse.
examples.zh: 这两位商业合伙人之间的激烈争执导致了公司的倒闭。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用搭配 have a quarrel with 或 pick a quarrel，表示口角或争执，正式与日常语境均可见。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 quarrel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不适当的, 不胜任的, 不健康的
lemmas.def_en: below the required standards for a purpose

examples.en: The contaminated tap water was declared totally unfit for human consumption.
examples.zh: 受污染的自来水被宣布完全不适合人类饮用。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与 for 或 to do 搭配，意为不适合、身体欠佳或不合格，多用于正式评价或体检报告中。

lemmas.def_zh: 使不合格，使不相宜，剥夺……的资格
lemmas.def_en: [T] To make someone or something unsuitable, incapable, or unqualified for a specific purpose or role.

examples.en: A severe back injury unfortunately unfitted him for further military service.
examples.zh: 严重的背伤不幸使他无法继续服兵役。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面正式动词，常用于 unfit sb. for sth. 结构，指某种状况或缺陷使某人不适合某项工作或职责。

lemmas.def_en: poor physical condition; being out of shape or out of condition (as from a life of ease and luxury)

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unfit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （使）变亮，照亮；（使）快活起来，（使）充满希望
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. To become brighter, or to make something brighter. 2. To become or make happier, more cheerful, or hopeful.

examples.en: Her face brightened with relief the moment she received the good news.
examples.zh: 一收到这个好消息，她的脸上顿时露出了释然的喜色。

lemmas.usage_note: 可用作及物或不及物动词，常与 up 搭配，指光线变亮或心情、面容变得容光焕发。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 brighten 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: large northern deer with enormous flattened antlers in the male; called `elk' in Europe and `moose' in North America

examples.en: We spotted a solitary elk grazing quietly at the edge of the pine forest.
examples.zh: 我们发现一只孤零零的麋鹿正在松树林边安静地吃草。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，单复数同形亦可加 -s，指大型鹿科动物（在北美多指加拿大马鹿，在欧洲指驼鹿）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 elk 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 锣, 大钟等的当当声
lemmas.def_en: a dull resonant sound as of a bell

examples.en: The deep bong of the grandfather clock resonated through the silent hallway.
examples.zh: 落地大钟沉闷的当当声在寂静的走廊里回荡。

lemmas.usage_note: 拟声名词，常与 of 连用，形容大钟或锣发出的沉重轰鸣声；亦指吸食器具（俚语）。

lemmas.def_zh: （大钟或锣等）咚咚地响，发出低沉悠长的撞击声
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] When a large bell or gong bongs, it makes a deep, resonant booming sound.

examples.en: The church bells bonged loudly across the quiet valley at noon.
examples.zh: 正午时分，教堂的钟声在静谧的山谷中轰鸣作响。

lemmas.usage_note: 作动词表示发出洪亮而沉重的当当钟声，可作及物或不及物动词，常用于文学描写。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bong 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 北欧人的, 日耳曼民族的, 北欧两项滑雪的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or constituting the Scandinavian group of languages

examples.en: She enjoys Nordic walking because it offers a full-body workout outdoors.
examples.zh: 她喜欢北欧式健走，因为这种户外运动能锻炼全身。

lemmas.usage_note: 首字母常大写，修饰文化、人种或冬季滑雪项目，如 Nordic skiing（越野滑雪）。

lemmas.def_zh: 北欧人, 日耳曼民族, 北欧两项滑雪
lemmas.def_en: the northern family of Germanic languages that are spoken in Scandinavia and Iceland

examples.en: As a skilled Nordic, he excels at both ski jumping and cross-country racing.
examples.zh: 作为一名出色的北欧两项选手，他兼长跳台滑雪与越野竞速。

lemmas.usage_note: 专指北欧人或北欧两项滑雪选手，多用于人类学、地理学或体育竞赛语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nordic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a word used in exclamations of confusion

examples.en: What the dickens are you doing in my office so late at night?
examples.zh: 大半夜的你到底在我办公室里干什么鬼名堂？

lemmas.usage_note: 老派口语感叹词或强调词，常以 the dickens 形式出现，用作 devil 的委婉替代表达。

lemmas.def_en: of or like the novels of Charles Dickens (especially with regard to poor social and economic conditions)

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dickens 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 漫谈，闲扯，语无伦次地说；漫步，漫游；（植物）蔓生
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (+ on/about) To talk or write for a long time in a confused, unfocused way. 2. [I] (+ through/over) To walk for pleasure in the countryside.

examples.en: The professor tended to ramble on about his travels instead of teaching the lesson.
examples.zh: 教授往往会偏离讲义，漫无边际地闲扯起自己的旅行见闻。

lemmas.usage_note: 指毫无目的地漫步，或语言表达冗长跑题（ramble on about），植物也可指藤蔓蔓生。

lemmas.def_en: a person who takes long walks in the country

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ramble 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 略为灰色的, 呈灰色的
lemmas.def_en: showing characteristics of age, especially having grey or white hair; -Coleridge

examples.en: The old sailor had a grizzly beard that weathered decades of sea storms.
examples.zh: 老水手留着花白的胡子，历经了数十载海上风暴的洗礼。

lemmas.usage_note: 作形容词表示毛发略带灰色的、灰白色的，多用于描写动物毛皮或老人的须发。

lemmas.def_en: powerful brownish-yellow bear of the uplands of western North America

examples.en: Hikers are strongly advised to carry bear spray to deter any curious grizzly.
examples.zh: 强烈建议徒步旅行者携带防熊喷雾，以防对人好奇的灰熊接近。

lemmas.usage_note: 北美大型灰熊（grizzly bear）的常用简称，常出现在野生动物与生态相关话题中。

lemmas.def_zh: 哭闹，啼哭抱怨（尤指小孩）；变成灰色
lemmas.def_en: [I] (informal) to whimper, fret, or complain continuously, especially of a child.

examples.en: The tired toddler began to grizzle when his mother put his toys away.
examples.zh: 当母亲收起玩具时，那个疲惫的幼儿开始哼唧啼哭。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 grizzly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 工会会员, 工联主义者
lemmas.def_en: a worker who belongs to a trade union

examples.en: The veteran unionist gave an inspiring speech advocating for workers' safety rights.
examples.zh: 这位资深工会会员发表了鼓舞人心的演说，积极倡导保障劳动者的安全权益。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，既指工会会员（trade unionist），在英爱政治语境中亦指主张维持联合王国的统一派。

lemmas.def_zh: 工会主义, 联合主义, 联邦主义
lemmas.def_en: the system or principles and theory of labor unions

examples.en: Trade unionism played a critical role in securing fair wages for workers.
examples.zh: 工会主义在为工人争取合理工资方面发挥了关键作用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unionist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: large room used mainly for dancing

examples.en: The hotel boasts a magnificent ballroom that can accommodate over five hundred guests.
examples.zh: 这家酒店拥有一间富丽堂皇的大舞厅，可容纳五百多位宾客。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常指用于举办正式舞会或大型宴会的大型厅堂，常与 dancing 搭配构成 ballroom dancing（国标舞）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ballroom 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 极其厌恶，憎恨，极其反感
lemmas.def_en: [T] To feel intense hatred and disgust for someone or something.

examples.en: I loathe doing housework on weekends when I could be relaxing outdoors.
examples.zh: 我极其讨厌周末做家务，那时我本可以在户外放松身心。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，表示极度厌恶或反感，语气强于 hate，常接名词或动名词作宾语，不用于进行时态。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 loathe 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 白血病, 白血球过多症
lemmas.def_en: malignant neoplasm of blood-forming tissues; characterized by abnormal proliferation of leukocytes; one of the four major types of cancer

examples.en: Recent advances in medical research have significantly improved survival rates for childhood leukemia.
examples.zh: 医学研究的最新进展已显著提高了儿童白血病的存活率。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学名词，指白血病，常与 acute（急性）、chronic（慢性）连用，为不可数名词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 leukemia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 薄雾, 阴霾, 疑惑
lemmas.def_en: atmospheric moisture or dust or smoke that causes reduced visibility

examples.en: A thick morning haze hung over the harbor, obscuring the distant skyline.
examples.zh: 浓重的晨雾笼罩着港口，遮蔽了远处的地平线。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指由于烟雾或热气引起的薄雾或阴霾，也可比喻精神或记忆上的迷糊、混沌状态。

lemmas.def_en: vagueness attributable to being not clearly defined

lemmas.def_zh: （恶作剧式）折磨，霸凌（新生或新成员）；（使）变朦胧
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. [T] (North American) To subject new members or recruits to humiliating, harsh, or abusive initiation tasks. 2. [I, T] To become or make hazy.

examples.en: Rising smoke from the nearby factory began to haze the afternoon sun.
examples.zh: 附近工厂升起的浓烟开始使午后的阳光变得朦胧。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可作不及物动词表示变朦胧，也可作及物动词表示使模糊；美式英语中亦可表示戏弄或折磨新生。

lemmas.def_zh: 朦胧的, 模糊的, 烟雾弥漫的
lemmas.def_en: filled or abounding with fog or mist

examples.en: She had only a hazy recollection of what had happened during the accident.
examples.zh: 她对事故发生时的情况只有模糊的记忆。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，既可形容天气或视线雾蒙蒙的，也可修饰记忆、想法等模糊不清，常作定语或表语。

lemmas.def_en: through a haze

examples.en: we saw the distant hills hazily

family_guide.root_logic: 以 haze 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a metric unit of length equal to one thousandth of a meter

examples.en: The engineer adjusted the lens by a fraction of a millimeter to achieve perfect focus.
examples.zh: 工程师将镜头微调了不到一毫米，以实现完美对焦。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，公制长度单位“毫米”，常用于精确测量语境，缩写为 mm。

lemmas.def_en: a metric unit of length equal to one thousandth of a meter

family_guide.root_logic: 以 millimeter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 照顾者, 看管者, 看守人
lemmas.def_en: a custodian who is hired to take care of something (property or a person)

examples.en: The school caretaker locked the main gates after all the students had left.
examples.zh: 所有学生离开后，学校看门人锁上了大门。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指照看房屋或设施的看管人，也可指照顾病弱者的照料者；亦可作定语表示看守性的、临时的。
