lemmas.usage_note: 既指为舞蹈、武打编排动作，也常比喻精心策划复杂的事件或政治行动，及物动词居多。

lemmas.def_en: someone who creates new dances

family_guide.root_logic: 以 choreograph 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可付的, 到期的, 应付的, 有利益的
lemmas.def_en: subject to or requiring payment especially as specified

examples.en: Please make sure the check is made payable to the company directly.
examples.zh: 请确保支票的收款人直接写为该公司。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作表语或后置定语，常见搭配 payable to（付给某人）或 payable on demand（见票即付）。

lemmas.def_en: a liability account showing how much is owed for goods and services purchased on credit

examples.en: The accountant spent the afternoon reconciling the firm's payables and receivables.
examples.zh: 会计花了整个下午核对公司的应付账款和应收账款。

lemmas.usage_note: 商业与财会术语中通常以复数形式 payables 出现，特指企业的“应付款项”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 payable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: capable of being imagined

examples.en: The rescue team used every imaginable resource to find the lost hikers.
examples.zh: 搜救队动用了所有能想到的资源去寻找失踪的徒步者。

lemmas.usage_note: 常置于 every、all、最高级修饰的名词之后作后置定语，用于加强“所能想到的”语气。

lemmas.def_zh: 不能想象的, 不可思议的
lemmas.def_en: totally unlikely

family_guide.root_logic: 以 imaginable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of various cosmetic preparations that are applied to the skin

examples.en: Apply a gentle lotion to dry skin after showering to lock in moisture.
examples.zh: 淋浴后涂抹温和的乳液于干燥皮肤上以锁住水分。

lemmas.usage_note: 指外用的洗剂、护肤乳液，常与 body, soothing, moisturizing 等词构成复合名词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lotion 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [I] (+ with) (formal or archaic) To agree, harmonize, or be in accord with something.

examples.en: The parties concording on the fundamental terms were able to sign the treaty peacefully.
examples.zh: 各方在基本条款上达成一致，从而得以和平签署条约。

lemmas.usage_note: 古英语或罕用法律、语法语境动词，意为“达成一致”或“使一致”，多作不及物动词后接 with。

lemmas.def_zh: 调和, 一致, 用语索引
lemmas.def_en: a harmonious state of things in general and of their properties (as of colors and sounds); congruity of parts with one another and with the whole

lemmas.def_zh: 和谐的, 相调和的, 一致的
lemmas.def_en: in keeping

examples.en: The research team obtained concordant results across three entirely independent laboratory trials.
examples.zh: 研究团队在三个完全独立的实验室测试中获得了相一致的结果。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 concord 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of medicine concerned with the study and treatment of tumors

examples.en: Advances in oncology have significantly improved survival rates for cancer patients.
examples.zh: 肿瘤学的进步极大地提高了癌症患者的生存率。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数医学专业名词，指肿瘤学，常作定语修饰 department, ward 或 specialist。

lemmas.def_en: a specialist in oncology
of or relating to or practicing oncology

examples.en: oncological nurse

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or practicing oncology

examples.en: oncological nurse

family_guide.root_logic: 以 oncology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: European butterfly having reddish-brown wings each marked with a purple eyespot

examples.en: Dressed in a flashy suit, he strutted around the party like a vain peacock.
examples.zh: 他穿着一身扎眼的西装，像只自负的孔雀一样在聚会上昂首阔步。

lemmas.usage_note: 字面指雄孔雀，在口语比喻中指爱炫耀外表或招摇过市的人，常具贬义或戏谑色彩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 peacock 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person employed to keep watch for some anticipated event

examples.en: Two armed soldiers stood sentinel at the entrance to the fortress throughout the night.
examples.zh: 两名全副武装的士兵整夜在要塞入口处站岗放哨。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面或军事语体中指负责警戒的哨兵，常搭配 stand sentinel over 表示警戒守护。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sentinel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a board that resembles a broad ski or a small surfboard; used in a standing position to slide down snow-covered slopes

examples.en: He strapped his boots securely onto the snowboard before heading down the steep slope.
examples.zh: 在冲下陡坡之前，他将靴子牢牢地固定在滑雪板上。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词表示单板滑雪所用的滑雪板，常见搭配有 ride a snowboard 或 wax a snowboard。

lemmas.def_en: someone who slides down snow-covered slopes while standing on a snowboard
[I] To glide down snow-covered slopes while standing on a snowboard.

examples.en: Every winter, they travel to the Alps to snowboard down the powdery mountain trails.
examples.zh: 每年冬天，他们都会去阿尔卑斯山，在积雪松软的山间雪道上进行单板滑雪。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，指进行单板滑雪运动，常接状语表示滑雪地点或技巧风格。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 snowboard 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having an oblique or slanting direction or position

examples.en: The frame hung skew on the wall, catching the attention of everyone who entered the gallery.
examples.zh: 画框歪歪扭扭地挂在墙上，引起了每个走进画廊的人的注意。

lemmas.usage_note: 用于形容线条、视角或统计分布不对称、歪斜的，常作表语或定语修饰线与面。

lemmas.def_zh: 曲解，使有偏向；偏斜，歪斜
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. To cause results, opinions, or data to be inaccurate, biased, or distorted. 2. To turn or place at an angle; to slant.

examples.en: The unexpected surge in holiday sales could skew the quarterly financial projections.
examples.zh: 假日销售额的出人意料激增可能会使该季度的财务预测产生偏差。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物或不及物动词，常与 results、data 连用，表示数据、观点被曲解或偏离常态。

lemmas.def_en: an oblique or slanting asymmetry

family_guide.root_logic: 以 skew 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (+ from) To obtain money, information, or agreement from someone by using threats, force, or intimidation.

examples.en: The corrupt official attempted to extort large sums of cash from local business owners.
examples.zh: 这名腐败官员企图从当地企业主手中勒索巨额现金。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常搭配 extort money/confessions from sb.，表示用暴力或威胁强行榨取。

lemmas.def_zh: 勒索, 敲诈, 强取
lemmas.def_en: an exorbitant charge
a criminal who extorts money from someone by threatening to expose embarrassing information about them

family_guide.root_logic: 以 extort 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To suspend or end a meeting, trial, or legislative session with the intention of resuming it later.

examples.en: The judge decided to adjourn the hearing until ten o'clock tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 法官决定休庭，将听证会推迟至明天上午十点继续进行。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式法律或会议用语，表示会议暂停延期，常搭配 adjourn until/for 或 adjourn to 换地点。

lemmas.def_zh: 延期, 休会, 休会期间
lemmas.def_en: the termination of a meeting

family_guide.root_logic: 以 adjourn 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a clear liquid secreted into the mouth by the salivary glands and mucous glands of the mouth; moistens the mouth and starts the digestion of starches

examples.en: The pleasant aroma of roasted meat stimulated the immediate production of saliva.
examples.zh: 烤肉诱人的香气立刻刺激了唾液的分泌。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，主要用于生理或医学语境，常与 produce、stimulate、sample 搭配使用。

lemmas.def_en: the secretion of saliva

lemmas.def_zh: 唾液的, 分泌唾液的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to saliva

examples.en: salivary gland

lemmas.def_zh: 分泌唾液，流口水；垂涎，极度渴望
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To produce saliva in the mouth. 2. [I] (+ over) To show great eagerness or anticipation for something.

examples.en: We salivated when he described the great meal

family_guide.root_logic: 以 saliva 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any opinions or doctrines at variance with the official or orthodox position

examples.en: In the Middle Ages, questioning church doctrines was deemed an act of unforgivable heresy.
examples.zh: 在中世纪，质疑教会教义被视为不可饶恕的异端行为。

lemmas.usage_note: 宗教或比喻指离经叛道的异端学说，常与 commit、condemn as 或 be guilty of 连用。

lemmas.def_en: characterized by departure from accepted beliefs or standards

family_guide.root_logic: 以 heresy 为核心的派生词族。
